controversial.usageZh: 形容词，通常修饰名词，如 a controversial idea/decision。可用于形容话题、决定、人物等，表示容易引发争论。语体上偏正式，但日常讨论中也常见。

examples.sentence: My brother chose a controversial red hat for the school trip.
examples.trans: 我哥哥为学校旅行选了一顶有争议的红帽子。

examples.sentence: The new rule about using phones at lunch is controversial among students.
examples.trans: 关于午餐时使用手机的新规定在学生中引起了争议。

examples.sentence: Whether schools should give homework on weekends remains a controversial question for many parents.
examples.trans: 学校是否应该在周末布置作业对许多家长来说仍然是一个有争议的问题。

examples.sentence: The scientist's controversial theory challenged ideas that had been accepted for decades.
examples.trans: 这位科学家有争议的理论挑战了几十年来被广泛接受的观点。

examples.sentence: Although the film received several awards, its portrayal of historical events remains deeply controversial.
examples.trans: 尽管这部电影获得了多个奖项，但它对历史事件的呈现仍然极具争议。

examples.sentence: The committee's decision to fund the controversial research project was met with both fierce criticism and cautious support from different academic circles.
examples.trans: 委员会资助这个有争议的研究项目的决定，在不同学术圈中既遭到了激烈的批评，也获得了谨慎的支持。

declare.usageZh: 及物动词，常用结构为 declare + that 从句或 declare + 名词。也可接复合宾语 declare sb./sth. + adj./n.。多用于正式场合，表示官方或公开地宣布。

examples.sentence: My dad declared that pizza is the best food in the world.
examples.trans: 我爸爸宣布披萨是世界上最好的食物。

examples.sentence: The captain declared the sports meeting open with a short speech.
examples.trans: 队长用简短的讲话宣布运动会开幕。

examples.sentence: The company declared that it would stop using plastic bags in all its stores by next year.
examples.trans: 该公司宣布将在明年之前在所有门店停止使用塑料袋。

examples.sentence: After reviewing the evidence, the court declared the contract invalid and ordered a full refund.
examples.trans: 在审查证据后，法院宣布合同无效，并责令全额退款。

examples.sentence: The newly elected president declared in her inaugural speech that tackling climate change would be her administration's top priority.
examples.trans: 新当选的总统在就职演说中宣布，应对气候变化将是她政府的首要任务。

examples.sentence: Despite mounting pressure from shareholders, the board refused to declare bankruptcy, insisting that the company could still recover through restructuring.
examples.trans: 尽管来自股东的压力越来越大，董事会仍拒绝宣布破产，坚称公司仍可通过重组恢复。

assign.usageZh: 及物动词，常用结构为 assign sb. sth. 或 assign sth. to sb.，也可用 assign sb. to do sth.。表示正式地把任务、工作或角色分派给某人。

examples.sentence: My mom assigned me the job of washing the dishes after dinner.
examples.trans: 妈妈分配给我晚饭后洗碗的任务。

examples.sentence: Our teacher assigned each group a different country to research for the geography project.
examples.trans: 老师给每个小组分配了一个不同的国家来为地理项目做研究。

examples.sentence: The manager assigned the new employee to work with an experienced colleague for the first month.
examples.trans: 经理指派新员工第一个月与一位有经验的同事一起工作。

examples.sentence: The editor assigned the young journalist to cover the local election, giving her a chance to prove herself.
examples.trans: 编辑指派这位年轻记者报道地方选举，给了她一个证明自己的机会。

examples.sentence: Each participant was randomly assigned a code number so that the researchers could analyze the data without bias.
examples.trans: 每位参与者被随机分配一个代码编号，以便研究人员能够无偏见地分析数据。

examples.sentence: The project manager assigned the most critical tasks to the senior engineers, while delegating routine maintenance work to the junior staff.
examples.trans: 项目经理将最关键的任务分配给资深工程师，同时将日常维护工作委派给初级员工。

routine.usageZh: 可作名词或形容词。作名词时表示“常规、例行公事”，常与 daily、morning、exercise 等词搭配；作形容词时表示“例行的、常规的”。

examples.sentence: My morning routine is to wash my face and brush my teeth.
examples.trans: 我早上的常规就是洗脸刷牙。

examples.sentence: After school, I follow the same routine: do homework, then play basketball.
examples.trans: 放学后，我遵循同样的流程：先做作业，然后打篮球。

examples.sentence: A regular sleep routine helps your body know when it is time to rest.
examples.trans: 规律的睡眠习惯能帮助你的身体知道什么时候该休息。

examples.sentence: Once you establish a study routine, preparing for exams becomes much less stressful.
examples.trans: 一旦你建立了学习常规，备考的压力就会小很多。

examples.sentence: Although routines can feel boring at times, they free up mental energy for more creative tasks.
examples.trans: 虽然常规有时会让人觉得无聊，但它们能节省脑力，用于更有创造性的任务。

examples.sentence: Athletes who stick to a carefully designed training routine are more likely to maintain peak performance throughout the season.
examples.trans: 坚持精心设计的训练常规的运动员，更有可能在整个赛季中保持最佳状态。

awareness.usageZh: 不可数名词，表示“意识、认识”。常与介词 of 连用，如 raise awareness of sth（提高对某事的意识）；也可与 that 从句连用。

examples.sentence: We should have awareness of road safety when we cross the street.
examples.trans: 我们过马路时应该有道路安全意识。

examples.sentence: The school held a fire drill to raise students' awareness of what to do in an emergency.
examples.trans: 学校举行了一次消防演习，以提高学生在紧急情况下该如何应对的意识。

examples.sentence: As children grow older, their awareness of other people's feelings becomes stronger.
examples.trans: 随着孩子长大，他们对他人感受的意识会变得更强。

examples.sentence: The campaign aims to increase public awareness of the dangers of plastic pollution in oceans.
examples.trans: 该活动旨在提高公众对海洋塑料污染危害的认识。

examples.sentence: A lack of cultural awareness can lead to misunderstandings even when both sides speak the same language.
examples.trans: 即使双方说同一种语言，缺乏文化意识也可能导致误解。

examples.sentence: Heightened awareness of mental health issues among teenagers has prompted schools to offer more counseling services.
examples.trans: 对青少年心理健康问题日益增强的关注促使学校提供更多咨询服务。

emotional.usageZh: 形容词，表示“情感的、情绪上的”。常修饰名词，如 emotional support（情感支持）、emotional well-being（情绪健康）。也可表示“易动感情的”。

family.meaning: 情感的，情绪上的；易动感情的
激起感情的，有感染力的

examples.sentence: My dog gives me emotional comfort when I feel sad.
examples.trans: 当我感到难过时，我的狗给我情感上的安慰。

examples.sentence: Saying goodbye to her best friend was an emotional moment for Lily.
examples.trans: 和最好的朋友告别对莉莉来说是一个情绪激动的时刻。

examples.sentence: Teenagers often need emotional support from their parents as much as they need financial help.
examples.trans: 青少年往往既需要父母的经济帮助，也同样需要情感上的支持。

examples.sentence: The coach emphasized that maintaining emotional control during a match is just as important as physical fitness.
examples.trans: 教练强调，在比赛中保持情绪控制与体能同样重要。

examples.sentence: While logical reasoning plays a key role in decision-making, emotional intelligence often determines how well we work with others.
examples.trans: 虽然逻辑推理在决策中起关键作用，但情商往往决定我们与他人合作的效果。

examples.sentence: Studies indicate that prolonged exposure to social media can intensify emotional vulnerability in adolescents, particularly regarding self-image.
examples.trans: 研究表明，长期接触社交媒体会加剧青少年的情绪脆弱性，尤其是在自我形象方面。

predictor.usageZh: 可数名词，意为“预测因素；预言者”。常与介词 of 或 for 连用，表示“某事的预测指标”。多用于说明性、学术性或较正式的语境中。

examples.sentence: Wearing a seat belt is a good predictor of staying safe in a car.
examples.trans: 系安全带是在车里保持安全的一个很好的预测因素。

examples.sentence: Eating fruit every day is a simple predictor of better health.
examples.trans: 每天吃水果是身体更健康的一个简单预测指标。

examples.sentence: A student's reading habit is often a strong predictor of success in school.
examples.trans: 学生的阅读习惯往往是学业成功的一个有力预测因素。

examples.sentence: The amount of sleep you get can serve as a reliable predictor of your concentration level.
examples.trans: 你的睡眠时长可以作为你注意力水平的一个可靠预测指标。

examples.sentence: Early interest in books is widely regarded as a key predictor of later academic achievement.
examples.trans: 早期对书籍的兴趣被广泛视为日后学业成就的一个关键预测因素。

examples.sentence: While income is often used as a predictor of life satisfaction, social connections may matter even more.
examples.trans: 虽然收入常被用作生活满意度的预测因素，但社会关系可能更为重要。

participate.usageZh: 不及物动词，意为“参与，参加”。常与介词 in 连用，如 participate in an activity。也可接 with，表示与某人一起参与。语体较正式，日常口语中也可用 take part in 替换。

examples.sentence: My sister wants to participate in the school art show.
examples.trans: 我妹妹想参加学校的艺术展。

examples.sentence: All the boys in our class will participate in the football game on Friday.
examples.trans: 我们班所有男生都将参加周五的足球比赛。

examples.sentence: If you participate in the clean-up activity, you can help make the park beautiful again.
examples.trans: 如果你参加这次清洁活动，就能帮助公园重新变美。

examples.sentence: Students who actively participate in class discussions tend to understand the material more deeply.
examples.trans: 积极参与课堂讨论的学生往往能更深入地理解所学内容。

examples.sentence: Rather than simply observing the experiment, every member of the group was expected to participate in collecting data.
examples.trans: 小组的每个成员都被期望参与收集数据，而不仅仅是观察实验。

examples.sentence: To participate meaningfully in a global economy, young people need both digital skills and cross-cultural awareness.
examples.trans: 要有意义地参与全球经济，年轻人既需要数字技能，也需要跨文化意识。

responsibility.usageZh: 不可数名词，表示抽象的责任概念；作可数名词时指具体职责。常与 take、have、share、accept 等动词搭配，也可用 take responsibility for 表示“为……负责”。

examples.sentence: Feeding the cat is my responsibility at home.
examples.trans: 喂猫是我在家里的责任。

examples.sentence: You should take responsibility for keeping your room clean.
examples.trans: 你应该负责保持自己的房间干净。

examples.sentence: As we grow older, we learn to take on more responsibilities in our family.
examples.trans: 随着年龄增长，我们学会在家庭中承担更多责任。

examples.sentence: Having a part-time job teaches teenagers how to handle responsibility before they enter the workforce.
examples.trans: 做兼职工作能让青少年在进入职场之前学会如何承担责任。

examples.sentence: Unlike personal freedom, which can be enjoyed alone, responsibility often involves considering how our choices affect others.
examples.trans: 与可以独自享受的个人自由不同，责任往往需要我们考虑自己的选择如何影响他人。

examples.sentence: A society that encourages individuals to accept responsibility for their own actions tends to build stronger trust among its members.
examples.trans: 一个鼓励个人为自己的行为承担责任的社会，往往能在成员之间建立更强的信任。

benefit.usageZh: 可作名词或动词。作名词时常用复数 benefits，表示“好处、益处”，常与 of/from 搭配。作动词时表示“使受益”或“得益于”，常用 benefit from 结构。

examples.sentence: Eating vegetables every day has many benefits for your body.
examples.trans: 每天吃蔬菜对你的身体有很多好处。

examples.sentence: Reading English stories benefits me a lot because I can learn new words in a fun way.
examples.trans: 读英语故事让我受益匪浅，因为我可以以有趣的方式学到新单词。

examples.sentence: If you exercise regularly, you will benefit from better sleep and more energy.
examples.trans: 如果你经常锻炼，你会受益于更好的睡眠和更充沛的精力。

examples.sentence: The new library benefits not only students but also local residents who want a quiet place to read.
examples.trans: 新图书馆不仅让学生受益，也让想要安静阅读场所的当地居民受益。

examples.sentence: While online courses offer flexibility, the lack of face-to-face interaction means some learners benefit far less than they would in a traditional classroom.
examples.trans: 虽然在线课程提供了灵活性，但缺乏面对面互动意味着一些学习者的收获远不如在传统课堂中。

examples.sentence: The long-term benefits of investing in early childhood education extend beyond individual achievement, shaping the overall productivity of society.
examples.trans: 投资幼儿教育的长期益处不仅限于个人成就，还塑造了社会的整体生产力。

survey.usageZh: 可作名词或动词。作名词时表示“调查；测量”，常与 conduct/do/carry out 搭配。作动词时表示“调查；审视；勘测”。

examples.sentence: Our teacher did a survey about our favorite sports last week.
examples.trans: 上周我们老师做了一项关于我们最喜欢的运动的调查。

examples.sentence: The survey shows that most students in our class go to bed after ten o'clock.
examples.trans: 调查显示，我们班大多数学生十点以后才睡觉。

examples.sentence: Before building the new park, the city government surveyed local people to hear their opinions.
examples.trans: 在修建新公园之前，市政府调查了当地居民以听取他们的意见。

examples.sentence: Having surveyed the damage caused by the storm, the rescue team decided to focus on the coastal areas first.
examples.trans: 在勘察了暴风雨造成的破坏后，救援队决定先集中处理沿海地区。

examples.sentence: A nationwide survey conducted last year revealed that nearly sixty percent of teenagers check their phones within five minutes of waking up.
examples.trans: 去年进行的一项全国性调查显示，近60%的青少年在醒来后五分钟内就会查看手机。

examples.sentence: The survey's methodology has been criticized for relying too heavily on self-reported data, which may not accurately reflect actual behavior.
examples.trans: 该调查的方法论因过度依赖自我报告的数据而受到批评，这些数据可能无法准确反映实际行为。

require.usageZh: 及物动词，表示“要求，需要”。常用结构为 require sb. to do sth. 或 require that 从句（从句中用虚拟语气）。也可直接接名词作宾语。

examples.sentence: This game requires two players.
examples.trans: 这个游戏需要两个玩家。

examples.sentence: Learning to swim requires a lot of practice and patience.
examples.trans: 学游泳需要大量的练习和耐心。

examples.sentence: The school requires all students to wear uniforms on Mondays.
examples.trans: 学校要求所有学生周一穿校服。

examples.sentence: Mastering a foreign language requires consistent effort over a long period rather than short bursts of intensive study.
examples.trans: 掌握一门外语需要长期持续的努力，而不是短时间的高强度学习。

examples.sentence: Unlike optional activities, the science project requires every student to submit a written report by the end of the term.
examples.trans: 与可选活动不同，这个科学项目要求每个学生在期末前提交一份书面报告。

examples.sentence: The new regulations require that all food manufacturers clearly label any genetically modified ingredients on their packaging.
examples.trans: 新规定要求所有食品制造商在包装上清楚标注任何转基因成分。

balance.usageZh: 可作名词或动词。名词表示“平衡、均衡”，常与 keep/lose/find 搭配；动词表示“使平衡、权衡”，常用 balance A with B 结构。口语和书面语都常见。

examples.sentence: Try to balance on one foot for ten seconds.
examples.trans: 试着单脚保持平衡十秒钟。

examples.sentence: You need to balance your time between homework and hobbies.
examples.trans: 你需要在作业和爱好之间平衡时间。

examples.sentence: She lost her balance and fell off the bike.
examples.trans: 她失去平衡，从自行车上摔了下来。

examples.sentence: A good diet balances the nutrients your body needs without adding too many calories.
examples.trans: 良好的饮食能平衡身体所需的营养，同时不增加过多热量。

examples.sentence: Unlike his brother, who spends every penny he earns, Tom has learned to balance saving for the future with enjoying the present.
examples.trans: 与他那个挣多少花多少的兄弟不同，汤姆学会了在为未来储蓄和享受当下之间取得平衡。

examples.sentence: The committee must balance the urgent demand for housing against the need to preserve green spaces for future generations.
examples.trans: 委员会必须在紧迫的住房需求与为后代保留绿地的需要之间进行权衡。

allowance.usageZh: 可数名词，表示“津贴、零用钱”。常与 give/get/receive/spend 等动词连用，也可指“限额、免税额”。英式英语中也可表示“允许量”。

examples.sentence: My parents give me ten yuan as my weekly allowance.
examples.trans: 我父母每周给我十元零用钱。

examples.sentence: He saved half of his allowance to buy a new football.
examples.trans: 他把一半零用钱存起来买一个新足球。

examples.sentence: If you finish all your chores, you will get your full allowance this week.
examples.trans: 如果你完成所有家务，这周就能拿到全额零用钱。

examples.sentence: Receiving a fixed monthly allowance teaches teenagers how to plan their spending before the next payment arrives.
examples.trans: 每月领取固定零用钱能教会青少年在下一次发钱之前如何规划开支。

examples.sentence: The company offers a generous travel allowance to employees who regularly visit clients outside the city.
examples.trans: 公司为经常去外地拜访客户的员工提供丰厚的差旅津贴。

examples.sentence: Under the new tax policy, the annual tax-free allowance for low-income families has been raised to ease their financial burden.
examples.trans: 根据新税收政策，低收入家庭的年度免税额度已提高，以减轻他们的经济负担。

untidy.usageZh: 形容词，表示“不整洁的、凌乱的”，反义词为 tidy。常用于描述房间、书桌、头发、外表等，口语和书面语均可使用。

examples.sentence: Your hair looks untidy after the wind.
examples.trans: 风吹过后，你的头发看起来乱乱的。

examples.sentence: Mom asked me to clean up my untidy desk before dinner.
examples.trans: 妈妈让我在晚饭前把凌乱的书桌收拾干净。

examples.sentence: He lost his keys again because his room was too untidy to find anything.
examples.trans: 他又把钥匙弄丢了，因为他的房间太乱，什么都找不到。

examples.sentence: Leaving your workspace untidy can make it harder to concentrate on the task at hand.
examples.trans: 把工作区域弄得凌乱不堪会让你更难集中精力处理手头的任务。

examples.sentence: While some creative people claim that an untidy desk inspires them, most studies suggest that a clean environment improves focus.
examples.trans: 虽然一些有创造力的人声称凌乱的书桌能激发灵感，但大多数研究表明，整洁的环境能提高专注力。

examples.sentence: The landlord refused to return the full deposit, arguing that the tenants had left the apartment in an untidy and damaged condition.
examples.trans: 房东拒绝退还全部押金，理由是租客把公寓弄得又乱又破。

control.usageZh: 可作名词或动词。作动词时是及物动词，直接跟宾语。常见搭配：take control of（掌控）、lose control（失控）、under control（处于控制之下）、remote control（遥控器）。名词常与 over/of 连用，表示对某事物的控制权。

examples.sentence: My little brother can't control his dog in the park.
examples.trans: 我弟弟在公园里管不住他的狗。

examples.sentence: You need to control your speed when you ride a bike near the school gate.
examples.trans: 你在学校门口附近骑自行车时需要控制速度。

examples.sentence: The fire spread so quickly that the firefighters could not control it for several hours.
examples.trans: 火势蔓延得太快，消防员花了几个小时才控制住。

examples.sentence: Learning to control your breathing is a useful skill for reducing stress before exams.
examples.trans: 学会控制呼吸是考试前减压的一项实用技能。

examples.sentence: Although she was clearly angry, she managed to control her voice and reply calmly.
examples.trans: 尽管她显然很生气，她还是控制住了自己的声音，平静地回答。

examples.sentence: The new policy aims to give local communities greater control over how public funds are spent.
examples.trans: 新政策旨在让当地社区对公共资金的使用方式拥有更大的控制权。

connected.usageZh: 形容词，常与 to 或 with 连用，表示“与……连接/相关”。也可作动词 connect 的过去分词。口语和书面语都常用，描述设备、关系、思想等。

examples.sentence: My phone is connected to the Wi-Fi at home.
examples.trans: 我的手机连上了家里的无线网络。

examples.sentence: The printer is connected to the computer with a long cable.
examples.trans: 打印机用一根长电缆连在电脑上。

examples.sentence: The two villages are connected by a narrow bridge over the river.
examples.trans: 这两个村庄由河上一座窄桥连接起来。

examples.sentence: Feeling connected to a community can greatly reduce loneliness among teenagers.
examples.trans: 与一个群体有联系的感觉可以大大减少青少年的孤独感。

examples.sentence: Although the two incidents seemed unrelated at first, investigators later found they were closely connected.
examples.trans: 虽然这两起事件起初看似无关，但调查人员后来发现它们密切相关。

examples.sentence: The rise in online learning is directly connected to the rapid development of digital technology over the past decade.
examples.trans: 在线学习的兴起与过去十年数字技术的快速发展直接相关。

excuses.usageZh: 可数名词，常用复数形式。常见搭配：make excuses（找借口）、accept excuses（接受借口）、no excuses（没有借口）。常与 for 连用，表示"为……找的借口"。注意与 excuse 作动词时读音不同（名词读 /ɪkˈskjuːs/，动词读 /ɪkˈskjuːz/）。

examples.sentence: He always makes excuses when he forgets his homework.
examples.trans: 他忘记做作业时总是找借口。

examples.sentence: Don't make excuses for being late; just get up earlier next time.
examples.trans: 别为迟到找借口；下次早点起床就行了。

examples.sentence: The teacher said she would not accept any excuses for missing the exam without a doctor's note.
examples.trans: 老师说，没有医生证明而缺考的任何借口她都不会接受。

examples.sentence: Instead of making excuses for your mistakes, try to learn from them and move forward.
examples.trans: 与其为自己的错误找借口，不如试着从中吸取教训并继续前进。

examples.sentence: The coach made it clear that there would be no excuses for poor performance after three months of training.
examples.trans: 教练明确表示，经过三个月的训练后，表现不佳没有任何借口。

examples.sentence: A culture of blame and excuses prevents organizations from identifying the real causes of failure.
examples.trans: 推卸责任和找借口的文化会阻碍组织找出失败的真正原因。

self-driving.usageZh: 复合形容词，通常放在名词前作定语，如 self-driving car（自动驾驶汽车）。也可与 technology、system、vehicle 等词搭配。多用于科技类或未来生活话题。

examples.sentence: My uncle bought a self-driving car last month.
examples.trans: 我叔叔上个月买了一辆自动驾驶汽车。

examples.sentence: A self-driving car can stop by itself when a person walks in front of it.
examples.trans: 当有人走到前面时，自动驾驶汽车可以自己停下来。

examples.sentence: Many people believe that self-driving buses will make city traffic safer and more convenient.
examples.trans: 许多人相信自动驾驶公交车会让城市交通更安全、更方便。

examples.sentence: Although self-driving technology still faces legal challenges, several companies have already begun testing it on public roads.
examples.trans: 尽管自动驾驶技术仍面临法律挑战，但几家公司已经开始在公共道路上进行测试。

examples.sentence: Unlike traditional cars, a self-driving vehicle relies on sensors and artificial intelligence rather than human judgment.
examples.trans: 与传统汽车不同，自动驾驶车辆依赖传感器和人工智能，而不是人的判断。

examples.sentence: The widespread adoption of self-driving vehicles could significantly reduce traffic accidents caused by human error, yet it also raises concerns about data privacy and job losses.
examples.trans: 自动驾驶车辆的广泛普及可以大幅减少由人为失误造成的交通事故，但同时也引发了人们对数据隐私和就业岗位流失的担忧。

far.usageZh: 可作形容词或副词，表示距离远或程度大。常见搭配：far from（远非，一点也不）、so far（到目前为止）、as far as I know（据我所知）。口语和书面语都很常用。

examples.sentence: The park is not far from my home.
examples.trans: 公园离我家不远。

examples.sentence: We walked so far that my legs started to hurt.
examples.trans: 我们走了那么远，我的腿开始疼了。

examples.sentence: As far as I know, the library is still open on Sundays.
examples.trans: 据我所知，图书馆周日仍然开放。

examples.sentence: The solution to the problem is far from perfect, but it is the best one we have at the moment.
examples.trans: 这个问题的解决方案远非完美，但它是我们目前最好的办法。

examples.sentence: Far more important than winning the competition is the experience and confidence you gain from taking part.
examples.trans: 比赢得比赛重要得多的是你从参与中获得的经验和信心。

examples.sentence: The impact of climate change extends far beyond rising temperatures, affecting food security, water supply, and public health across the globe.
examples.trans: 气候变化的影响远不止气温上升，它还影响全球的粮食安全、水资源供应和公共卫生。

sooner.usageZh: soon 的比较级，表示“更早、更快”。常见搭配：sooner than（比……更早）、sooner or later（迟早）、the sooner the better（越快越好）、no sooner...than...（一……就……，用于正式书面语）。

examples.sentence: If you go to bed early, you will get up sooner.
examples.trans: 如果你早点睡觉，你就会更早起床。

examples.sentence: The earlier we leave, the sooner we will arrive at the park.
examples.trans: 我们出发得越早，到公园就越早。

examples.sentence: Sooner or later, you will understand why your parents made that rule.
examples.trans: 你迟早会明白为什么你父母定了那条规矩。

examples.sentence: Having finished his homework sooner than expected, Tom decided to watch a short documentary.
examples.trans: 比预期更早完成作业后，汤姆决定看一部简短的纪录片。

examples.sentence: The sooner we acknowledge the limits of current technology, the more realistic our plans for the future will be.
examples.trans: 我们越早承认当前技术的局限，我们对未来的计划就会越现实。

examples.sentence: No sooner had the new policy been announced than several major companies began adjusting their investment strategies.
examples.trans: 新政策刚一公布，几家大公司就开始调整它们的投资策略。

centuries.usageZh: 可数名词，是 century 的复数形式。常与介词 in、for、over 搭配，表示“几个世纪以来”或“在几个世纪中”。可用于历史、建筑、传统等话题，书面和口语都常见。

examples.sentence: This old tree has lived for centuries.
examples.trans: 这棵老树已经活了好几百年了。

examples.sentence: People have used this bridge for centuries to cross the river.
examples.trans: 几个世纪以来，人们一直用这座桥过河。

examples.sentence: Over the centuries, the town has changed from a small village into a busy city.
examples.trans: 几个世纪以来，这个小镇已经从一个小村庄变成了一座繁忙的城市。

examples.sentence: The tradition of making paper by hand has been passed down for centuries in this region.
examples.trans: 手工造纸的传统在这个地区已经传承了几个世纪。

examples.sentence: Unlike modern buildings, these stone houses were designed to last for centuries without major repairs.
examples.trans: 与现代建筑不同，这些石屋的设计使其无需大修就能使用数百年。

examples.sentence: The manuscripts, carefully preserved for centuries in the monastery library, offer a rare glimpse into medieval scientific thought.
examples.trans: 这些在修道院图书馆中被精心保存了数个世纪的手稿，为人们了解中世纪科学思想提供了难得的窗口。

telepresence.usageZh: 不可数名词，属于科技领域术语。常与 robot、technology、system、device 等词搭配，表示“远程呈现”或“网真”技术。多用于正式或科技类语境。

examples.sentence: My dad uses a telepresence robot to say goodnight to me when he is away.
examples.trans: 爸爸不在家时，会用远程呈现机器人跟我道晚安。

examples.sentence: With telepresence technology, students can visit a museum without leaving their classroom.
examples.trans: 借助远程呈现技术，学生们不用离开教室就能参观博物馆。

examples.sentence: The company uses telepresence systems so that workers in different cities can hold meetings together.
examples.trans: 这家公司使用远程呈现系统，让不同城市的员工可以一起开会。

examples.sentence: Telepresence allows surgeons to guide operations in distant hospitals with remarkable precision.
examples.trans: 远程呈现技术使外科医生能够以极高的精确度指导远距离医院的手术。

examples.sentence: Although telepresence cannot fully replace face-to-face interaction, it significantly reduces the need for business travel.
examples.trans: 尽管远程呈现无法完全取代面对面的交流，但它大大减少了商务出行的需求。

examples.sentence: The integration of telepresence into remote education has transformed the way expert knowledge is delivered to underserved communities.
examples.trans: 远程呈现技术融入远程教育，改变了专业知识向资源不足地区传递的方式。

escalators.usageZh: 可数名词，是 escalator 的复数形式。常与 take、ride、stand on、hold the handrail 等动词搭配。多用于商场、地铁站、机场等公共场所的指示或描述。

examples.sentence: We took the escalators to the third floor of the mall.
examples.trans: 我们乘自动扶梯到了商场三楼。

examples.sentence: The escalators at the subway station are always busy during rush hour.
examples.trans: 地铁站的自动扶梯在高峰时段总是很拥挤。

examples.sentence: When the escalators stopped working, many people had to use the stairs instead.
examples.trans: 自动扶梯停止运行后，许多人不得不改走楼梯。

examples.sentence: Airports install extra escalators to help passengers move quickly between arrival and departure levels.
examples.trans: 机场安装额外的自动扶梯，以帮助乘客在到达层和出发层之间快速移动。

examples.sentence: Unlike elevators, escalators keep moving continuously, which makes them more suitable for handling large crowds.
examples.trans: 与电梯不同，自动扶梯持续运行，因此更适合应对大人流量。

examples.sentence: Regular maintenance of escalators is essential in public transport hubs, where a sudden breakdown can cause severe congestion and safety risks.
examples.trans: 在公共交通枢纽，自动扶梯的定期维护至关重要，因为突然故障可能导致严重拥堵和安全隐患。

population.usageZh: 不可数名词，指某地全部居民。表示“人口数量”时可用 a population of...。常用搭配：population growth, population density, the population of...。

family.meaning: 有人居住的；人口稠密的

examples.sentence: The population of our city is about two million.
examples.trans: 我们城市的人口大约有两百万。

examples.sentence: China has a much larger population than most other countries.
examples.trans: 中国的人口比大多数其他国家多得多。

examples.sentence: The population of this small town has grown quickly in the past ten years.
examples.trans: 这个小镇的人口在过去十年里增长很快。

examples.sentence: Governments need accurate population data to plan schools, hospitals, and public transport.
examples.trans: 政府需要准确的人口数据来规划学校、医院和公共交通。

examples.sentence: A declining population can lead to labour shortages and slower economic growth.
examples.trans: 人口下降会导致劳动力短缺和经济增长放缓。

examples.sentence: The ageing population in many developed countries has placed increasing pressure on healthcare systems and pension funds.
examples.trans: 许多发达国家的人口老龄化给医疗体系和养老基金带来了越来越大的压力。

modern.usageZh: 形容词，表示“现代的；现代化的”。常修饰 technology, society, art, architecture 等名词。反义词：ancient, old-fashioned, traditional。

examples.sentence: My school has a modern library with many computers.
examples.trans: 我的学校有一个现代化的图书馆，里面有很多电脑。

examples.sentence: Modern cars use less fuel than older ones.
examples.trans: 现代汽车比旧款汽车耗油更少。

examples.sentence: The museum shows both ancient and modern art from around the world.
examples.trans: 这座博物馆展出世界各地的古代和现代艺术。

examples.sentence: Modern medicine has made it possible to treat diseases that were once considered fatal.
examples.trans: 现代医学使治疗曾经被认为致命的疾病成为可能。

examples.sentence: While traditional methods still have value, modern farming techniques have greatly increased food production.
examples.trans: 虽然传统方法仍有价值，但现代农业技术大大提高了粮食产量。

examples.sentence: The rapid spread of modern communication technologies has fundamentally changed the way people work, learn, and interact.
examples.trans: 现代通信技术的迅速普及从根本上改变了人们工作、学习和互动的方式。

greener.usageZh: 形容词，是 green（环保的）的比较级，表示“更环保的”。常与名词连用，如 greener choice / lifestyle / city。口语和书面语都可用，写作中常用于讨论环境话题。

examples.sentence: Riding a bike to school is greener than taking a car.
examples.trans: 骑自行车上学比坐汽车更环保。

examples.sentence: My family is trying to live a greener life by using less plastic.
examples.trans: 我们家正在通过减少使用塑料来努力过更环保的生活。

examples.sentence: If we plant more trees in the city, the air will become cleaner and the streets will look greener.
examples.trans: 如果我们在城市里种更多的树，空气会变得更干净，街道也会看起来更绿。

examples.sentence: Switching to solar energy is considered a greener alternative to burning coal for electricity.
examples.trans: 改用太阳能被认为是比燃煤发电更环保的替代方案。

examples.sentence: While electric cars are often marketed as a greener option, the production of their batteries still raises environmental concerns.
examples.trans: 虽然电动汽车常被宣传为更环保的选择，但其电池的生产仍然引发环境方面的担忧。

examples.sentence: Governments that prioritize greener infrastructure, such as efficient public transit and renewable energy grids, tend to see long-term economic as well as ecological benefits.
examples.trans: 优先发展更环保的基础设施（如高效公共交通和可再生能源电网）的政府，往往能获得长期的经济和生态双重效益。

investing.usageZh: 动词 invest 的动名词形式，意为“投资”。常见搭配：investing in sth（投资于某事物）、investing time/money/energy in。既可用于金融语境，也可用于抽象意义，如“投入精力”。

examples.sentence: My dad is investing some money in a small shop.
examples.trans: 我爸爸正在往一家小商店里投一些钱。

examples.sentence: Investing in a good dictionary is a smart way to improve your English.
examples.trans: 投资买一本好词典是提高英语水平的一个明智方法。

examples.sentence: She believes that investing time in reading every day will help her do better in all subjects.
examples.trans: 她相信每天投入时间阅读会帮助她在所有科目上做得更好。

examples.sentence: Before investing in any company, it is essential to research its financial history and market position.
examples.trans: 在投资任何公司之前，研究其财务历史和市场地位是至关重要的。

examples.sentence: Rather than spending money on short-lived pleasures, investing in skills and knowledge yields returns that last a lifetime.
examples.trans: 与其把钱花在短暂的享乐上，不如投资于技能和知识，这会带来持续一生的回报。

examples.sentence: Investing heavily in early childhood education has been shown to reduce social inequality and boost overall economic productivity in the long run.
examples.trans: 大量投资于儿童早期教育已被证明从长远来看能减少社会不平等并提升整体经济生产力。

technologies.usageZh: 名词，是 technology 的复数形式，指多种不同的技术。常与形容词连用，如 new / modern / digital / medical technologies。在正式写作中常用于列举或概括某一领域的技术发展。

examples.sentence: New technologies make our phones faster and smaller.
examples.trans: 新技术让我们的手机更快、更小。

examples.sentence: Many schools are using new technologies to help students learn in different ways.
examples.trans: 许多学校正在使用新技术来帮助学生以不同的方式学习。

examples.sentence: As communication technologies develop, people in different countries can work together more easily than ever before.
examples.trans: 随着通信技术的发展，不同国家的人们比以往任何时候都更容易一起工作。

examples.sentence: The rapid spread of digital technologies has transformed the way businesses reach their customers.
examples.trans: 数字技术的迅速普及已经改变了企业接触客户的方式。

examples.sentence: While renewable energy technologies have become more affordable, their widespread adoption still depends heavily on government policy.
examples.trans: 尽管可再生能源技术已变得更加便宜，但其广泛采用仍在很大程度上取决于政府政策。

examples.sentence: Emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence and gene editing hold enormous potential, yet they also pose ethical challenges that society must address carefully.
examples.trans: 人工智能和基因编辑等新兴技术拥有巨大的潜力，但它们也带来了社会必须谨慎应对的伦理挑战。

implementing.usageZh: 动词 implement 的动名词形式，意为“实施；执行”。常用于正式语境，如政策、计划、系统等。常见搭配：implement a plan/policy/strategy/system。

examples.sentence: My dad is implementing a new rule at home: no phones at dinner.
examples.trans: 我爸爸正在家里实施一条新规定：吃饭时不看手机。

examples.sentence: The school is implementing a recycling program to reduce waste.
examples.trans: 学校正在实施一项回收计划来减少垃圾。

examples.sentence: Implementing the new timetable took longer than the teachers expected.
examples.trans: 实施新课程表花费的时间比老师们预期的要长。

examples.sentence: Implementing a consistent study routine often leads to better academic performance.
examples.trans: 实施一套稳定的学习常规往往能带来更好的学业表现。

examples.sentence: While implementing the software upgrade, the team discovered several unexpected compatibility issues.
examples.trans: 在实施软件升级的过程中，团队发现了几个意想不到的兼容性问题。

examples.sentence: Implementing evidence-based policies requires not only political will but also reliable data and sustained public engagement.
examples.trans: 实施基于证据的政策不仅需要政治意愿，还需要可靠的数据和持续的公众参与。

integrating.usageZh: 动词 integrate 的动名词形式，意为“整合；使成为一体”。常与 into 或 with 连用，表示将某物融入另一体系或与另一事物结合。常见搭配：integrate A into B / integrate A with B。

examples.sentence: Our teacher is good at integrating games into English lessons.
examples.trans: 我们的老师很擅长把游戏融入英语课。

examples.sentence: Integrating new students into the class takes patience and kindness.
examples.trans: 让新同学融入班级需要耐心和善意。

examples.sentence: The app is popular because it does a great job of integrating photos, notes, and reminders.
examples.trans: 这款应用很受欢迎，因为它在整合照片、笔记和提醒方面做得很好。

examples.sentence: Integrating traditional teaching methods with digital tools can make lessons more engaging.
examples.trans: 将传统教学方法与数字工具相结合，可以让课堂更有吸引力。

examples.sentence: The challenge lies not in collecting data but in integrating it into a coherent framework for decision-making.
examples.trans: 挑战不在于收集数据，而在于将数据整合成一个连贯的决策框架。

examples.sentence: Integrating renewable energy sources into the existing power grid demands substantial investment in storage and transmission infrastructure.
examples.trans: 将可再生能源并入现有电网需要在储能和输电基础设施上进行大量投资。

funds.usageZh: 常用复数形式，意为“资金；基金”。作为可数名词，常与动词 raise（筹集）、save（节省）、allocate（拨出）、manage（管理）等搭配。可用于正式或日常语境。

examples.sentence: We raised some funds by selling old books at the school fair.
examples.trans: 我们在学校义卖会上卖旧书筹集了一些资金。

examples.sentence: The library needs more funds to buy new science books.
examples.trans: 图书馆需要更多资金来购买新的科学书籍。

examples.sentence: The charity used the funds to build a clean water system in the village.
examples.trans: 该慈善机构用这笔资金在村里修建了一个净水系统。

examples.sentence: The government has allocated extra funds to improve rural healthcare services.
examples.trans: 政府已拨出额外资金来改善农村医疗服务。

examples.sentence: Without sufficient funds, even the most promising research projects may be forced to shut down.
examples.trans: 如果没有足够的资金，即使是最有前景的研究项目也可能被迫终止。

examples.sentence: The board decided to redirect funds originally earmarked for marketing toward product development and quality control.
examples.trans: 董事会决定将原本指定用于市场营销的资金转投向产品开发和质量控制。

completely.usageZh: 副词，表示“完全地、彻底地”，常修饰动词、形容词或其他副词。可搭配 agree、forget、change、different、wrong 等词。语气比 very 或 quite 更强。

examples.sentence: I completely forgot to bring my homework today.
examples.trans: 我今天完全忘记带作业了。

examples.sentence: After the rain stopped, the sky completely cleared up.
examples.trans: 雨停之后，天空完全放晴了。

examples.sentence: The new shopping mall looks completely different from what I expected.
examples.trans: 这个新购物中心看起来和我预想的完全不一样。

examples.sentence: By the time the firefighters arrived, the old building had been completely destroyed by the fire.
examples.trans: 消防员到达时，那座旧建筑已经被大火完全烧毁。

examples.sentence: It is completely understandable that you feel nervous before such an important interview.
examples.trans: 在如此重要的面试前感到紧张是完全能够理解的。

examples.sentence: Unless the data is completely accurate, any conclusion drawn from it may lead to misleading decisions in medical research.
examples.trans: 除非数据完全准确，否则从中得出的任何结论都可能在医学研究中导致误导性决策。

do housework.usageZh: 动词短语，通常作谓语，表示“做家务”。可用于各种时态，如一般现在时、过去时、进行时等。口语和书面语都常用，常与 help、share、have to 等搭配。

examples.sentence: I help my mum do housework on Sundays.
examples.trans: 星期天我帮妈妈做家务。

examples.sentence: My brother never does housework because he is always busy with his model planes.
examples.trans: 我哥哥从来不做家务，因为他总是忙着弄他的飞机模型。

examples.sentence: If we share the housework, everyone in the family can have more free time.
examples.trans: 如果我们分担家务，家里每个人都能有更多空闲时间。

examples.sentence: Doing housework together not only keeps the flat tidy but also gives us a chance to chat.
examples.trans: 一起做家务不仅能让公寓保持整洁，还能给我们聊天的机会。

examples.sentence: Rather than complaining about the mess, she simply rolled up her sleeves and started doing housework.
examples.trans: 她没有抱怨屋子乱，而是卷起袖子开始做家务。

examples.sentence: Children who are expected to do housework from an early age tend to develop a stronger sense of responsibility and independence.
examples.trans: 从小就被要求做家务的孩子，往往能培养出更强的责任感和独立性。

get done.usageZh: 动词短语，表示“被完成；做完”，常以事物作主语，如 work、homework、task 等。口语中常用，可搭配 by、before、on time 等。注意与 get something done（让别人做某事）区分。

examples.sentence: My homework gets done before I watch TV.
examples.trans: 我看电视之前先把作业做完。

examples.sentence: The dishes got done quickly because we washed them together.
examples.trans: 碗碟很快就洗完了，因为我们一起洗的。

examples.sentence: Once the cleaning gets done, we can go out and play basketball.
examples.trans: 一旦打扫完成，我们就可以出去打篮球。

examples.sentence: With so many emails to answer, I doubt the report will get done before the meeting.
examples.trans: 有这么多邮件要回，我怀疑报告在开会前做不完。

examples.sentence: The project finally got done, but only after weeks of late nights and endless revisions.
examples.trans: 项目终于完成了，但那是经过数周熬夜和无休止修改之后的事。

examples.sentence: Unless every item on the checklist gets done by Friday, the launch will have to be postponed.
examples.trans: 除非清单上的每一项都在周五前完成，否则发布将不得不推迟。

for starters.usageZh: 固定短语，常用于句首，引出第一个理由、建议或例子，意为“首先；第一”。口语色彩较浓，后面常接一个完整句子。也可说 for a start。

examples.sentence: For starters, we need some eggs and milk.
examples.trans: 首先，我们需要一些鸡蛋和牛奶。

examples.sentence: For starters, you should turn off your phone when you do homework.
examples.trans: 首先，你做作业时应该把手机关掉。

examples.sentence: For starters, the bus is cheaper than a taxi, and it is also better for the environment.
examples.trans: 首先，公交车比出租车便宜，而且对环境也更好。

examples.sentence: For starters, learning to cook a few simple dishes will save you a lot of money when you live alone.
examples.trans: 首先，学会做几道简单的菜，你一个人住的时候能省下不少钱。

examples.sentence: For starters, the new policy fails to address the real needs of small businesses, let alone the wider economy.
examples.trans: 首先，新政策未能解决小企业的真正需求，更不用说整体经济了。

examples.sentence: For starters, the evidence suggests that early exposure to a second language significantly improves cognitive flexibility in later years.
examples.trans: 首先，证据表明，早期接触第二语言能显著提升日后认知灵活性。

turn down.usageZh: 动词短语，可分开使用，如 'turn the music down'。表示调低音量、温度或亮度等。也可表示拒绝邀请或提议，但本义侧重“调低”。口语和书面语都常见。

examples.sentence: Please turn down the TV. The baby is sleeping.
examples.trans: 请把电视调低。宝宝在睡觉。

examples.sentence: Dad asked me to turn down the radio because he was on the phone.
examples.trans: 爸爸让我把收音机调低，因为他在打电话。

examples.sentence: If the music is too loud, you can turn down the volume with this button.
examples.trans: 如果音乐太响，你可以用这个按钮把音量调低。

examples.sentence: Having realized the noise was disturbing the neighbors, she turned down the speaker immediately.
examples.trans: 意识到噪音打扰了邻居，她立刻把音箱调低了。

examples.sentence: Rather than asking them to leave, he simply turned down the background music and continued the meeting.
examples.trans: 他没有让他们离开，只是把背景音乐调低，然后继续开会。

examples.sentence: The technician turned the amplifier down to a level that would not interfere with the recording equipment nearby.
examples.trans: 技术员把功放调低到不会干扰附近录音设备的程度。

far from.usageZh: 介词短语，后接名词、代词或动名词。可表示实际距离远，也可表示抽象意义上的“远非、完全不”。常用于否定某种预期或印象，语气比 not 更强烈。口语和书面语均可使用。

examples.sentence: My grandparents live far from the city center.
examples.trans: 我爷爷奶奶住在离市中心很远的地方。

examples.sentence: The bus stop is far from our school, so we walk for ten minutes.
examples.trans: 公交站离我们学校很远，所以我们走了十分钟。

examples.sentence: After a week of rain, the ground was far from dry enough for the match.
examples.trans: 下了一周雨后，地面远没有干到能进行比赛的程度。

examples.sentence: Having read the reviews, I found the film far from disappointing.
examples.trans: 看了评论之后，我发现这部电影远非令人失望。

examples.sentence: Far from being a burden, the new policy actually reduced costs for most families.
examples.trans: 新政策远非负担，实际上为大多数家庭降低了成本。

examples.sentence: The evidence presented in court was far from conclusive, leaving the jury with serious doubts.
examples.trans: 法庭上呈现的证据远非确凿，让陪审团产生了严重疑虑。

take place.usageZh: 动词短语，不及物，不能用于被动语态。主语通常是事件、会议、变化、事故等。常与时间或地点状语连用，表示“发生”或“举行”。比 happen 更正式，常用于计划中的活动。

examples.sentence: The party will take place at my house on Saturday.
examples.trans: 聚会将于周六在我家举行。

examples.sentence: A big change took place in our town after the new library opened.
examples.trans: 新图书馆开放后，我们镇上发生了很大的变化。

examples.sentence: The interview will take place in the school hall at nine o'clock sharp.
examples.trans: 面试将于九点整在学校礼堂进行。

examples.sentence: The ceremony is scheduled to take place outdoors, weather permitting.
examples.trans: 如果天气允许，仪式计划在户外举行。

examples.sentence: A dramatic shift in public opinion took place after the documentary was broadcast.
examples.trans: 纪录片播出后，公众舆论发生了戏剧性的转变。

examples.sentence: Negotiations between the two parties are expected to take place behind closed doors next month.
examples.trans: 双方之间的谈判预计将于下月闭门进行。

in the business.usageZh: 固定短语，表示“从事某个行业或领域”，常与 of 连用，后接动名词或名词。口语和书面语均可使用，语气较正式，强调职业或商业身份。

examples.sentence: My uncle is in the business of selling fresh fruit.
examples.trans: 我叔叔做卖新鲜水果的生意。

examples.sentence: Her family has been in the business of making shoes for over twenty years.
examples.trans: 她家做鞋的生意已经二十多年了。

examples.sentence: If you are in the business of repairing phones, you need to keep up with new models.
examples.trans: 如果你从事手机维修这一行，就需要跟上新机型的步伐。

examples.sentence: Companies that are in the business of collecting personal data must now follow stricter privacy laws.
examples.trans: 从事收集个人数据业务的公司现在必须遵守更严格的隐私法。

examples.sentence: Unlike traditional publishers, the platform is in the business of connecting writers directly with readers.
examples.trans: 与传统出版商不同，该平台做的是将作者与读者直接连接起来的业务。

examples.sentence: Having spent decades in the business of urban planning, she was invited to advise on the city's smart infrastructure project.
examples.trans: 由于在城市规划行业深耕数十年，她受邀为该市的智慧基础设施项目提供咨询。

get children to do.usageZh: 动词短语，结构为 get + 宾语 + to + 动词原形，表示“让/说服某人做某事”。语气比 make 温和，强调通过沟通或引导达到目的。常用于谈论教育、家庭或管理场景。

examples.sentence: I can't get my little brother to brush his teeth before bed.
examples.trans: 我没法让我弟弟睡前刷牙。

examples.sentence: The coach got the children to warm up before the football match started.
examples.trans: 教练让孩子们在足球比赛开始前先热身。

examples.sentence: It is not always easy to get children to share their toys with others.
examples.trans: 让孩子们与他人分享玩具并不总是容易的事。

examples.sentence: By turning the cleanup into a game, the teacher got the children to tidy the classroom without complaining.
examples.trans: 通过把打扫变成游戏，老师让孩子们毫无怨言地整理了教室。

examples.sentence: Getting children to take responsibility for their own learning requires patience rather than pressure.
examples.trans: 让孩子对自己的学习负责需要的是耐心，而不是压力。

examples.sentence: The campaign aims to get children to adopt healthier eating habits by involving parents and schools in the process.
examples.trans: 该活动旨在通过让家长和学校参与其中，使孩子们养成更健康的饮食习惯。

accept no excuses.usageZh: 动词短语，表示“不接受任何借口”，语气坚决，常用于规则、纪律或严肃要求的语境。可作谓语，也可用于祈使句。中文常译为“不容借口”或“不接受任何理由”。

examples.sentence: My dad accepts no excuses when it comes to doing homework.
examples.trans: 在写作业这件事上，我爸爸不接受任何借口。

examples.sentence: The swimming coach accepts no excuses for missing practice.
examples.trans: 游泳教练不接受任何缺席训练的理由。

examples.sentence: Our school accepts no excuses for cheating on exams, no matter what the reason is.
examples.trans: 我们学校对考试作弊不容任何借口，无论原因是什么。

examples.sentence: The manager made it clear that she would accept no excuses for missing the project deadline.
examples.trans: 经理明确表示，她不会接受任何错过项目截止日期的借口。

examples.sentence: A strict teacher accepts no excuses, yet a wise one also teaches students how to plan ahead so that excuses become unnecessary.
examples.trans: 严格的老师不容借口，但明智的老师还会教学生如何提前规划，使借口变得没有必要。

examples.sentence: In high-risk industries, safety inspectors are trained to accept no excuses when basic protective measures have been ignored.
examples.trans: 在高风险行业中，安全检查人员被训练成在基本防护措施被忽视时不容任何借口。

over and over again.usageZh: 副词短语，作状语修饰动词，表示动作反复发生。常与持续性动词连用，如 read、practice、tell。口语和书面语均可使用，语气比 simply 'again' 更强调次数之多。

examples.sentence: My little brother watches the same cartoon over and over again.
examples.trans: 我弟弟一遍又一遍地看同一部动画片。

examples.sentence: She read the new words over and over again before the English test.
examples.trans: 英语考试前，她一遍又一遍地读那些生词。

examples.sentence: The teacher asked us to listen to the tape over and over again until we could follow it easily.
examples.trans: 老师让我们一遍又一遍地听录音，直到我们能轻松跟上。

examples.sentence: Having failed the driving test twice, he practiced parking over and over again in the empty lot.
examples.trans: 两次驾照考试失败后，他在空停车场里一遍又一遍地练习停车。

examples.sentence: Rather than explaining the rule over and over again, the coach drew a simple diagram on the board.
examples.trans: 教练没有一遍又一遍地解释规则，而是在白板上画了一个简单的示意图。

examples.sentence: The same historical pattern has repeated itself over and over again, yet each generation seems convinced that its circumstances are entirely unique.
examples.trans: 同样的历史模式一遍又一遍地重演，然而每一代人似乎都坚信自己所处的境况是完全独特的。

send the right message.usageZh: 动词短语，'send' 为动词，'the right message' 作宾语。常用于讨论某种行为、政策或言论对他人产生的影响。可接 'to sb' 表示对象。语体偏正式，常见于议论文和新闻报道。

examples.sentence: Saying thank you sends the right message to your friends.
examples.trans: 说谢谢会给你的朋友传递正确的信息。

examples.sentence: When parents recycle at home, they send the right message to their children about caring for the earth.
examples.trans: 父母在家做垃圾分类回收时，他们向孩子传递了关爱地球的正确信息。

examples.sentence: If teachers always arrive on time, they send the right message about the importance of punctuality.
examples.trans: 如果老师总是准时到，他们就传递了守时重要性的正确信息。

examples.sentence: By refusing to accept gifts from clients, the company sends the right message about its commitment to fair business practices.
examples.trans: 通过拒绝接受客户的礼物，该公司传递了其对公平商业行为承诺的正确信息。

examples.sentence: A government that invests heavily in public libraries sends the right message about the value it places on lifelong learning.
examples.trans: 一个大力投资公共图书馆的政府，传递了其对终身学习价值的正确信息。

examples.sentence: Punishing only the whistleblower while ignoring the actual misconduct sends entirely the wrong message to those who might consider speaking up in the future.
examples.trans: 只惩罚举报人而忽视实际的不当行为，向那些未来可能考虑发声的人传递了完全错误的信息。

do their share.usageZh: 动词短语，'do' 为动词，'their share' 为宾语，指'他们应承担的那份工作或责任'。常与 'of' 连用，如 do their share of the housework。主语可为单数或复数，代词相应变化。

examples.sentence: My sister and I do our share of the dishes after dinner.
examples.trans: 晚饭后，我和姐姐做我们那份洗碗的活儿。

examples.sentence: Everyone in the family should do their share of the cleaning on weekends.
examples.trans: 周末家里的每个人都应该做自己那份清洁工作。

examples.sentence: If each member does their share of the research, the group presentation will be ready on time.
examples.trans: 如果每个成员都完成自己那份研究，小组展示就能按时准备好。

examples.sentence: The project collapsed because several team members refused to do their share of the data analysis.
examples.trans: 项目失败了，因为几个团队成员拒绝完成自己那份数据分析工作。

examples.sentence: While the volunteers were eager to help, the organizers made sure that every participant did their share of the physical labor.
examples.trans: 虽然志愿者们都很热心帮忙，组织者仍确保每位参与者都完成了自己那份体力劳动。

examples.sentence: A society cannot function fairly unless every citizen is willing to do their share, whether by paying taxes, serving on juries, or simply obeying the law.
examples.trans: 除非每个公民都愿意尽自己那份责任——无论是纳税、担任陪审员，还是仅仅遵守法律——否则社会无法公平运转。

turn up.usageZh: 动词短语，及物或不及物。及物时表示“调高（音量、温度等）”，宾语可放在 turn 与 up 之间或 up 之后；不及物时表示“出现、露面”。口语和书面语均常用。

examples.sentence: Can you turn up the radio? My favorite song is on.
examples.trans: 你能把收音机声音调大吗？我最喜欢的歌正在播。

examples.sentence: It's cold in here—let me turn up the heater a bit.
examples.trans: 这里有点冷，让我把暖气调高一点。

examples.sentence: If you turn up the volume too high, you may hurt your ears.
examples.trans: 如果你把音量调得太高，可能会伤到耳朵。

examples.sentence: She turned up late for the meeting, which made the manager rather unhappy.
examples.trans: 她开会迟到了，这让经理很不高兴。

examples.sentence: The missing documents turned up under a pile of old newspapers, much to our relief.
examples.trans: 丢失的文件在一堆旧报纸下面出现了，这让我们大大松了一口气。

examples.sentence: Despite the heavy rain, a surprisingly large number of volunteers turned up to help with the cleanup.
examples.trans: 尽管下着大雨，仍有数量惊人的志愿者到场帮忙清理。

one way out.usageZh: 名词短语，常作表语或主语补足语，表示“一个出路、一个解决办法”。可单独使用，也可后接 of 短语说明摆脱的具体困境。语体偏正式，常见于议论文和演讲。

examples.sentence: When I lost my key, calling my mom was one way out.
examples.trans: 当我丢了钥匙时，给妈妈打电话是一个解决办法。

examples.sentence: If you don't understand the math problem, asking the teacher is one way out.
examples.trans: 如果你不懂这道数学题，问老师是一个解决办法。

examples.sentence: When the road was blocked, taking the small path through the park was one way out.
examples.trans: 当道路被堵住时，走穿过公园的小路是一条出路。

examples.sentence: For many students struggling with stress, learning to manage time better is one way out.
examples.trans: 对许多因压力而苦恼的学生来说，学会更好地管理时间是一个解决办法。

examples.sentence: Rather than giving up entirely, negotiating a fairer agreement proved to be one way out of the conflict.
examples.trans: 与其完全放弃，谈判达成一个更公平的协议被证明是摆脱这场冲突的一个出路。

examples.sentence: When a community faces rising unemployment, investing in local small businesses may offer one way out of the economic downturn.
examples.trans: 当一个社区面临失业率上升时，投资当地小企业可能为摆脱经济衰退提供一条出路。

sooner than you think.usageZh: 副词短语，常放在句末作状语，表示某事发生得比预期更早。sooner 是 soon 的比较级，than you think 构成比较状语从句。用于提醒对方不要低估事情到来的速度。

examples.sentence: Summer holiday will come sooner than you think.
examples.trans: 暑假会比你想象的来得更快。

examples.sentence: If you practice every day, your English will improve sooner than you think.
examples.trans: 如果你每天练习，你的英语会比你想象的进步得更快。

examples.sentence: The exam results will be announced sooner than you think, so start reviewing now.
examples.trans: 考试成绩会比你想象的更早公布，所以现在就开始复习吧。

examples.sentence: With the rapid development of AI, driverless cars may arrive sooner than you think.
examples.trans: 随着人工智能的快速发展，无人驾驶汽车可能比你想象的更早到来。

examples.sentence: Once you start saving a small amount each month, financial independence can come sooner than you think.
examples.trans: 一旦你开始每月存一小笔钱，财务独立可能比你想象的来得更快。

examples.sentence: Given the accelerating pace of climate change, the consequences may hit coastal cities sooner than you think.
examples.trans: 鉴于气候变化加速的趋势，其后果可能比你想象的更早冲击沿海城市。

sense of responsibility.usageZh: 名词短语，常与动词如 'develop' 或 'have' 连用。中文：表示负责任的感觉，常用于描述个人品质。

examples.sentence: Volunteering helps young people develop a strong sense of responsibility.
examples.trans: 志愿服务帮助年轻人培养强烈的责任感。

take part in.usageZh: 动词短语，后接名词或动名词，如 'take part in a meeting'。中文：表示参加某项活动或事件。

examples.sentence: Students are encouraged to take part in school clubs and activities.
examples.trans: 鼓励学生参加学校的俱乐部和活动。

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'should' for Advice / 情态动词'should'表建议
grammar.title: 情态动词 should 表建议：从 should 到 ought to / had better / be supposed to
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verb 'should' for Advice: should, ought to, had better, be supposed to
grammar.usage:
should 是英语中最常用的表“建议、劝告、责任、义务”的情态动词，核心含义是“应该做某事”，表示说话人认为某事是正确、合理或可取的。其基本结构为：should + 动词原形。否定形式是 should not（缩写 shouldn't）+ 动词原形；疑问形式是把 should 提到主语之前，即 Should + 主语 + 动词原形...?。例如：You should apologize to her.（你应该向她道歉。）/ You shouldn't stay up so late.（你不应该熬夜到这么晚。）/ Should I call the doctor?（我应该给医生打电话吗？）

在近义结构方面，should 的语气比 must 弱。must 表示“必须”，带有强制性或命令色彩；should 表示“应该”，更多是建议或劝说，对方可以选择不听从。ought to 与 should 意思非常接近，但 ought to 在书面语和正式语体中更常见，且更强调道义上的责任。had better 意为“最好做某事”，语气比 should 更强，常含有“如果不这样做就会有不好后果”的警告意味。be supposed to 表示“按理应该、被期望做某事”，强调外部规则、约定或社会期待，与 should 的主观建议有所不同。

初中阶段，should 主要出现在“提建议”的交际场景中，如生病、学习、生活习惯等，常与 Why don't you...? / What about...? 等句型互换。高中阶段，should 的用法进一步拓展：一是用于“should + have + 过去分词”表示“本应该做某事而实际上没做”，否定式 shouldn't have done 表示“本不应该做某事而实际上做了”，这是高考的重要考点；二是 should 可用于表示“竟然、万一”的虚拟语气或惊讶语气，如 It is strange that he should say that.（他竟然说那种话，真奇怪。）；三是 should 在 suggest, advise, recommend, insist, demand 等动词后的 that 从句中，构成“should + 动词原形”的虚拟语气，其中 should 常可省略。

易错点一：should 后面必须接动词原形，不能接带 to 的不定式，也不能接动词的 -ing 形式或过去式。易错点二：should 是情态动词，没有第三人称单数变化，不能说 He shoulds。易错点三：should 与 ought to 虽然意思相近，但否定形式不同：shouldn't do 表示“不应该做”，ought not to do 中的 to 不能省略。易错点四：should have done 与 should do 的时间指向不同，前者针对过去，后者针对现在或将来，做题时要根据时间状语判断。
forms: 肯定：主语 + should + 动词原形
否定：主语 + should not (shouldn't) + 动词原形
疑问：Should + 主语 + 动词原形...?
过去建议：主语 + should have + 过去分词（本应该做而未做）
过去否定：主语 + shouldn't have + 过去分词（本不该做而做了）
近义替换：主语 + ought to / had better / be supposed to + 动词原形
notes: should 后必须接动词原形，不可接 to do、doing 或过去式；高考语法填空常在此处设空。
should have done 表示“过去本应做而未做”，含责备或遗憾语气；shouldn't have done 表示“过去本不该做却做了”，两者都是高考完形和语法填空的高频考点。
ought to 的否定是 ought not to，to 不能省略；在书面语中 ought to 比 should 更正式，语域更高。
had better 语气比 should 更强，带有警告意味，常暗示不做的后果；其否定形式是 had better not，不是 hadn't better。
在 suggest / advise / recommend / insist / demand 等动词后的 that 从句中，should 常可省略，构成虚拟语气，如 He suggested that she (should) leave early. 高考改错题常考 should 的省略或保留。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense (has/have + past participle) / 现在完成时 (has/have + 过去分词)
grammar.title: 现在完成时：has/have + 过去分词（含 for/since/already/yet/ever/never 及与一般过去时的对比）
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense: has/have + past participle
grammar.usage:
现在完成时的核心结构是“has/have + 过去分词”。主语为第三人称单数时用 has，其余人称用 have。肯定句如：She has taken the medicine. 否定句在 has/have 后加 not，如：They haven't finished the work. 一般疑问句把 has/have 提到主语前，如：Have you ever been to Shanghai? 回答时用 Yes, I have. / No, I haven't. 特殊疑问句则在疑问词后接 has/have + 主语 + 过去分词，如：What have you done?

现在完成时主要表达两种含义：一是过去发生的动作对现在有影响或结果，动作本身可能已经结束，但结果仍然存在；二是动作从过去开始一直持续到现在，并且有可能继续持续下去。第一种含义常与 already, just, yet, ever, never 等连用，第二种含义常与 for + 时间段、since + 时间点/从句连用。

与一般过去时的对比是高中阶段的核心考点。一般过去时只强调动作发生在过去某个具体时间，常与 yesterday, last week, in 2010, two days ago 等明确的过去时间状语连用；而现在完成时不与具体过去时间连用，它关注的是过去与现在的联系。例如：I saw the film yesterday. 强调“昨天看了”这个过去事实；I have seen the film. 强调“我已经看过了”，言下之意是现在知道内容，不必再看。

初中阶段通常只要求掌握现在完成时的基本构成、already/yet/for/since 的简单用法，以及 have been to 与 have gone to 的区别。高中阶段则进一步要求：理解现在完成时与一般过去时在语境中的细微差异；掌握现在完成进行时（have/has been doing）与现在完成时的区别；在书面表达中准确使用现在完成时描述变化、经历和持续状态；注意瞬间动词（如 buy, borrow, leave, die, join）在现在完成时中不能与 for/since 时间段直接连用，需转换为延续性表达。

易错点一：把瞬间动词与 for/since 连用。不能说 He has bought the car for two years. 应改为 He has had the car for two years. 或 He bought the car two years ago. 易错点二：在现在完成时句子中使用具体过去时间。不能说 I have finished my homework yesterday. 应改为 I finished my homework yesterday. 或 I have already finished my homework. 易错点三：have been to 与 have gone to 混淆。have been to 表示“去过某地（已回来）”，have gone to 表示“去了某地（还没回来）”。易错点四：since 从句中动词时态误用。since 引导的时间状语从句通常用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时，如：We have known each other since we met in 2015.
forms: 肯定句：主语 + has/have + 过去分词 + 其他
否定句：主语 + has/have + not + 过去分词 + 其他
一般疑问句：Has/Have + 主语 + 过去分词 + 其他？
特殊疑问句：疑问词 + has/have + 主语 + 过去分词 + 其他？
持续用法：主语 + has/have + 过去分词 + for + 时间段 / since + 时间点或从句
经历用法：主语 + has/have + ever/never + 过去分词（或 have been to + 地点）
notes: 瞬间动词（buy, borrow, leave, die, join, arrive 等）的现在完成时不能直接与 for/since 时间段连用，高考书面表达中需转换为延续性动词或改用一般过去时。
现在完成时不与 yesterday, last week, in 2010, two days ago 等具体过去时间状语连用，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
since 引导时间状语从句时，从句谓语通常用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时；since 后接时间点时，主句同样用现在完成时。
have been to（去过已回）、have gone to（去了未回）、have been in（待在某地一段时间）三者在语域和语义上差异明显，高中写作中需根据语境准确选用。
在书面语中，现在完成时与 already, just, yet, recently, so far, up to now, in the past few years 等词搭配时，要注意 already 和 just 通常用于肯定句，yet 用于否定句和疑问句。

exercises.explain: for three years 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时正确。

exercises.q: They have gone to the park. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Have they gone to the park?
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句把 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: He can swim. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.explain: can 表示能力时可与 be able to 互换。

exercises.q: I have went to Shanghai twice.
exercises.answer: I have gone to Shanghai twice.
exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，不是 went。

exercises.q: Great changes ______ in our hometown over the past ten years.
exercises.explain: over the past ten years 表示从过去到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The town ______ (change) a lot since I moved here.
exercises.explain: since 引导的时间状语从句要求主句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He has joined the club for two years.
exercises.explain: join 是短暂性动词，不能与 for two years 连用，应改为 has been in。

exercises.q: He came to this school three years ago. (用 for three years 改写)
exercises.answer: He has been at this school for three years.
exercises.explain: 短暂性动词 come 需转换为持续性表达 be at。

exercises.q: I have lived here since five years.
exercises.answer: I have lived here for five years.
exercises.explain: five years 是时间段，应用 for 而不是 since。

exercises.q: I ______ my English teacher since I left primary school.
exercises.explain: since 引导的时间状语从句常与现在完成时主句连用。

exercises.q: —Where is Tom? —He ______ to the library.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示“去了某地还没回来”，符合语境。

exercises.q: We ______ each other since we were children.
exercises.explain: since we were children 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ the book twice. She knows it very well.
exercises.explain: twice 表示到现在为止的次数，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ never ______ (be) to such a beautiful place.
exercises.explain: never 与现在完成时连用，表示“从未去过”。

exercises.q: So far, they ______ (plant) over 500 trees.
exercises.explain: so far 意为“到目前为止”，常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: I have bought this bike for three years.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂性动词，不能与 for 时间段连用，应改为 have had。

exercises.q: The film began ten minutes ago. (用 for ten minutes 改写)
exercises.answer: The film has been on for ten minutes.
exercises.explain: 短暂性动词 begin 需转换为持续性表达 be on。

exercises.q: She could read when she was four. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.answer: She was able to read when she was four.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去能力时可与 was/were able to 互换。

exercises.q: She has already went to bed.
exercises.answer: She has already gone to bed.
exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，不是 went。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived, the meeting ______ for half an hour.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，表示“过去的过去”，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: Great changes ______ (take) place in the towns that we ______ (live) in for centuries.
exercises.explain: 两个动作都从过去持续或影响到现在，均用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He has gone to Shanghai three times this year.
exercises.explain: 表示“去过某地”应用 has been to，has gone to 表示“去了还没回来”。

exercises.q: He joined the army two years ago. (用 for two years 改写)
exercises.answer: He has been in the army for two years.
exercises.explain: 短暂性动词 join 需转换为持续性表达 be in。

exercises.q: I have bought this car since 2019.
exercises.answer: I have had this car since 2019.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂性动词，不能与 since 连用，应改为持续性动词 have。

exercises.q: It is the first time that I ______ such an exciting match.
exercises.explain: It is the first time that 从句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The old couple ______ in this town since they got married.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句可用现在完成进行时强调持续。

exercises.q: —______ you ______ the new policy? —Not yet.
exercises.explain: Not yet 表明对话用现在完成时询问是否已听说。

exercises.q: The number of visitors to the museum ______ greatly in recent years.
exercises.explain: in recent years 表示从过去到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: By the end of last year, they ______ (complete) the project.
exercises.explain: by the end of last year 表示到过去某时间为止，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ (work) in this company since she graduated from university.
exercises.explain: since 引导的时间状语从句要求主句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The town has changed greatly since I have left it.
exercises.explain: since 从句应用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I have never read such an interesting novel before. (改为同义句)
exercises.answer: This is the most interesting novel I have ever read.
exercises.explain: 用最高级结构转换，表达“从未读过这么有趣的小说”。

exercises.q: She may be at home now. (用 might 改写，表示更不确定)

exercises.q: The great changes have been taken place in our town.

exercises.explain: take place 是不及物动词短语，没有被动语态。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can go out and play now.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去完成的动作对现在有影响，所以用 have finished。

exercises.q: We ______ (already / eat) our lunch, so we are not hungry.
exercises.explain: already 用于现在完成时肯定句，表示“已经做了某事”。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have seen this film yesterday." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是具体的过去时间，应与一般过去时连用，不能用现在完成时。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: I have finished my homework.

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: He have gone to the library.
exercises.answer: He has gone to the library.

exercises.q: She ______ in this town since she was a child.

exercises.q: They ______ the new movie yet.

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ to Beijing?

exercises.q: He ______ (not / finish) his work yet.

exercises.q: How long ______ you ______ (live) here?

exercises.q: The sentence "She has lived here for five years." means she still lives here now.

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: They have visited the museum.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时的一般疑问句将 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.explain: by the time 引导的时间状语从句用一般过去时，主句用过去完成时表示先发生的动作。

exercises.explain: since 2015 与现在完成时连用，表示从2015年持续到现在的动作。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The archaeologists have discovered the ancient tomb before the construction began.

exercises.explain: before 引导的从句用一般过去时，主句应用过去完成时表示先发生的动作。

grammar.key: Passive Voice (Present Simple) / 被动语态 (一般现在时)
grammar.title: 被动语态（一般现在时）及进行时被动拓展：am/is/are + done / being done
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice (Present Simple) and Present Continuous Passive
grammar.usage:
被动语态的核心作用是调整句子的信息焦点：当动作的执行者不重要、未知或无需提及时，把受事者（动作的承受者）放到主语位置。一般现在时被动语态的基本结构为 am/is/are + 过去分词，表示经常性、习惯性或客观存在的动作与状态。肯定句如 English is spoken in many countries. 否定句在 be 动词后加 not，如 The room is not cleaned every day. 一般疑问句将 be 动词提到句首，如 Is this book written in English? 特殊疑问句则在疑问词后接 be 动词，如 Where are these cars made?

高中阶段需要进一步区分一般现在时被动与现在进行时被动。现在进行时被动结构为 am/is/are + being + 过去分词，强调动作此刻正在进行或现阶段正在发生，例如 The bridge is being repaired now. 而一般现在时被动更多表示常态、规律或事实，例如 The bridge is repaired every year. 两者不可混用。

与近义结构对比：被动语态与主动语态的区别在于主语是动作的承受者还是执行者。主动句 They clean the classroom every day. 强调执行者 they；被动句 The classroom is cleaned every day. 强调教室被打扫这一事实。此外，被动语态中的 by + 执行者通常可以省略，只有在需要强调执行者时才保留，如 This painting was painted by a famous artist. 但一般现在时被动中 by 短语出现频率较低，因为执行者往往不重要。

初中阶段主要要求掌握一般现在时、一般过去时和一般将来时的被动语态，能进行主动与被动的转换。高中阶段则要求掌握进行时被动、完成时被动以及情态动词被动等更复杂结构，并能在阅读和写作中根据语境主动选择被动语态以增强客观性、正式感或突出受事者。

易错点：1) 过去分词拼写错误，尤其是不规则动词，如 write-wrote-written, build-built-built, speak-spoke-spoken；2) 混淆 be 动词的数和时态，主语为第三人称单数时用 is，复数用 are；3) 把不及物动词用于被动语态，如 happen, appear, disappear, take place 等没有被动形式；4) 在现在进行时被动中漏掉 being，写成 The road is repaired now. 意思就变成了“这条路现在被修好了”，而非“正在被修”。
forms: 一般现在时被动肯定式：主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词 (+ by + 执行者)
一般现在时被动否定式：主语 + am/is/are + not + 过去分词
一般现在时被动疑问式：Am/Is/Are + 主语 + 过去分词 (+ 其他)?
现在进行时被动肯定式：主语 + am/is/are + being + 过去分词
现在进行时被动否定式：主语 + am/is/are + not + being + 过去分词
主动转被动：主动句宾语 → 被动句主语；主动句谓语 → be + 过去分词；主动句主语 → by + 宾语（可省略）
notes: 高考书面表达中，被动语态常用于描述流程、报告现象或表达客观事实，如 It is believed that... / The project is expected to...，避免过多使用“人们认为”“大家觉得”等主观表达。
注意不及物动词没有被动语态，如 happen, take place, belong to, consist of 等，不能说 The accident was happened last night. 应说 The accident happened last night.
现在进行时被动中的 being 不可省略，省略后时态含义改变：The house is being painted.（正在被粉刷） vs The house is painted every year.（每年被粉刷）。
在正式语域中，by + 执行者常被省略以突出动作本身；但若执行者是具体且重要的信息，则保留，如 The law was passed by the government.
部分动词如 give, send, offer, teach 等可接双宾语，变为被动语态时有两种方式，如 He gave me a book. → I was given a book. / A book was given to me. 高考中常考查第一种形式。

examples.cn: 这种汽车是中国制造的吗？

examples.cn: 这条路正在被维修，所以我们不得不走另一条路线。

exercises.q: The classroom ______ every day.
exercises.explain: 一般现在时被动语态用 am/is/are + 过去分词，主语 classroom 是单数，所以用 is cleaned。

exercises.q: The room ______ (clean) every morning.
exercises.explain: 一般现在时被动语态：is + 过去分词 cleaned。

exercises.q: The sentence "The room is cleaned every day." is in the passive voice.
exercises.explain: is cleaned 是一般现在时被动语态结构，所以该句是被动语态。

exercises.q: People speak English in the UK. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: English is spoken in the UK.
exercises.explain: 主动句宾语 English 变为主语，用 is + spoken 构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The room are cleaned every day.
exercises.answer: The room is cleaned every day.
exercises.explain: 主语 room 是单数，be 动词应用 is 而不是 are。

exercises.q: English ______ in many countries.
exercises.explain: English 是单数不可数名词，被动语态用 is + 过去分词 spoken。

exercises.q: The windows ______ every week.
exercises.explain: 主语 windows 是复数，一般现在时被动语态用 are + 过去分词。

exercises.q: This book ______ by many students.
exercises.explain: read 的过去分词还是 read，主语 book 是单数，所以用 is read。

exercises.q: The food ______ by my mother.
exercises.explain: 一般现在时被动语态结构为 is + 过去分词，cook 的过去分词是 cooked。

exercises.q: These trees ______ (water) every day.
exercises.explain: 主语 trees 是复数，被动语态用 are + 过去分词 watered。

exercises.q: The homework ______ (do) by the students.
exercises.explain: homework 是不可数名词，被动语态用 is + 过去分词 done。

exercises.q: The sentence "He cleans the room every day." is in the passive voice.
exercises.explain: 该句是主动语态，主语 He 是动作的执行者，不是被动语态。

exercises.q: They make cars in this factory. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Cars are made in this factory.
exercises.explain: 主动句宾语 cars 变为主语，用 are + made 构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The teacher teaches us English. (改为被动语态，以 English 开头)
exercises.answer: English is taught to us by the teacher.
exercises.explain: English 作主语，被动语态用 is taught，by 引出动作执行者。

exercises.q: English is speak in many countries.
exercises.answer: English is spoken in many countries.
exercises.explain: 被动语态中动词要用过去分词 spoken，不能用原形 speak。

exercises.q: The new library ______ next month.
exercises.explain: next month 表示将来，用 will be + 过去分词表示将来被动。

exercises.q: The classroom ______ (not clean) every day.
exercises.explain: 一般现在时被动语态的否定形式：is not + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The sentence "The cake is being made by my mother now." means the cake is already finished.
exercises.explain: is being made 是现在进行时被动，表示蛋糕正在被制作，还没有完成。

exercises.q: They clean the park every Sunday. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The park is cleaned every Sunday.
exercises.explain: 主动句宾语 the park 变为主语，用 is cleaned 构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The letters are send every morning.
exercises.answer: The letters are sent every morning.
exercises.explain: send 的过去分词是 sent，被动语态中要用过去分词形式。

exercises.q: A lot of trees ______ in our city every year.
exercises.explain: 主语 trees 是复数，一般现在时被动语态用 are + planted。

exercises.q: The bridge ______ at the moment, so we can't cross it.
exercises.explain: at the moment 表示此刻正在进行的动作，用现在进行时被动 is being + 过去分词。

exercises.q: These photos ______ by my father last year.
exercises.explain: last year 表示过去，主语 photos 是复数，用 were + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The song ______ by a famous singer.
exercises.explain: sing 的过去分词是 sung，被动语态用 is sung。

exercises.q: ______ the rooms ______ (clean) every day?
exercises.explain: 一般现在时被动语态的一般疑问句：Are + 主语 + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The work ______ (finish) by them yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 表示过去，主语 work 不可数，用 was + 过去分词。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The window was broken by Tom", Tom is the person who did the action.
exercises.explain: by Tom 表示动作的执行者是 Tom，即打破窗户的人。

exercises.q: The homework is done by the students. (改为主动语态)
exercises.explain: 被动句中的 by the students 变为主语，谓语动词用主动形式 do。

exercises.q: This song is sing by many people.

exercises.q: The old building ______ (pull) down last week.

exercises.q: The problem ______ by the scientists now.

exercises.q: The windows ______ (break) by the strong wind last night.

exercises.q: They plant flowers in the garden every spring. (改为被动语态)

exercises.q: The dishes are wash by my father after dinner.

exercises.q: Many trees ______ every year to make our city greener.

exercises.q: Look! The road ______ by the workers at the moment.
exercises.explain: Look 和 at the moment 表示正在发生，道路正在被修，用现在进行时被动。

exercises.q: English ______ in many countries around the world.

exercises.q: The classroom ______ every day after school.

exercises.q: The homework ______ (check) by the teacher right now.

grammar.key: Future with 'will' for Prediction / 用'will'表预测的未来时
grammar.title: 用 will 表预测的未来时（拓展：will / be going to / may / might 的预测差异）
grammar.titleEn: Future with 'will' for Prediction (Extended: will vs. be going to vs. may/might)
grammar.usage:
“will + 动词原形”是英语中表达对将来情况做出预测的核心结构之一。它表示说话人基于自己的看法、经验、判断或想象，认为某事在未来很有可能发生，但并不一定已有现成的计划或眼前的证据。肯定句用“主语 + will + 动词原形”，否定句用“主语 + will not (won't) + 动词原形”，一般疑问句将 will 提到主语之前，特殊疑问句则在疑问词后接 will。

在初中阶段，学生主要接触 will 表示“将要”的简单预测，如天气、未来职业、科技发展等，常与 I think / I hope / probably / maybe 等搭配。到了高中阶段，需要进一步区分 will 与 be going to 在预测功能上的差异：will 更偏向说话人的主观判断、信念或对较远未来的推测；be going to 则常用于基于当前可见迹象做出的预测，或已经计划好的事情。此外，高中阶段还应引入 may / might 表示“可能性较低”的预测，形成从“较确定”到“较不确定”的预测梯度。

易错点一：把 will 当作万能将来时，忽视 be going to 在“有迹象预测”中的优势。例如看到乌云密布，更自然的是“It's going to rain.”而不是“It will rain.”。易错点二：在条件状语从句和时间状语从句中误用 will 表将来预测，如“If it will rain tomorrow”应改为“If it rains tomorrow”。易错点三：混淆 will 表预测与 will 表即时决定、承诺、意愿等功能，需要根据语境判断。易错点四：过度使用 will，使书面表达显得绝对化，高中写作中可适当用 may / might / be likely to 等表达更严谨的推测语气。
forms: 肯定预测：主语 + will + 动词原形
否定预测：主语 + will not (won't) + 动词原形
一般疑问：Will + 主语 + 动词原形?
特殊疑问：疑问词 + will + 主语 + 动词原形?
较不确定预测：主语 + may / might + 动词原形
基于迹象的预测：主语 + be going to + 动词原形
notes: 高考书面表达中，表达预测时不要通篇只用 will，可交替使用 be likely to、may well、might 等，体现语域和推测程度的层次感。
will 表预测时通常不与现在证据直接挂钩，若前文已出现明显迹象，优先考虑 be going to。
在 if / when / as soon as 等引导的时间和条件状语从句中，用一般现在时表将来，不用 will。
may / might 表预测时语域更正式、语气更弱，适合在议论文或说明文中表达不确定推断。
注意 will 在科技、环境、社会话题中常与 probably、perhaps、surely 等副词连用，以调整预测的确定程度。

examples.en: I think it will rain tomorrow.
examples.cn: 我认为明天会下雨。

examples.en: Robots will help us with more tasks in the future.
examples.cn: 未来机器人将帮助我们完成更多任务。

examples.en: Look at those dark clouds—it's going to rain soon.
examples.cn: 看那些乌云——很快就要下雨了。

examples.en: Self-driving cars will find the nearest parking space themselves.
examples.cn: 自动驾驶汽车将自行找到最近的停车位。

examples.en: If the city installs more sensors, traffic flow will improve significantly.
examples.cn: 如果这座城市安装更多传感器，交通流量将显著改善。

examples.en: Such policies may well reshape urban life, though the long-term effects might not be fully predictable.
examples.cn: 此类政策很可能会重塑城市生活，尽管长期影响可能无法完全预测。

exercises.q: I think it ______ sunny tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 用 will + 动词原形表示对未来的预测。

exercises.q: She thinks the train ______ arrive at 8 o'clock tonight.
exercises.explain: think 后接将来预测，用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: The sentence "It will rains tomorrow" is correct.
exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形，rain 不能加 s。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative: He will come to the party.
exercises.answer: He will not come to the party.
exercises.explain: will 的否定形式是 will not 或 won't。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: He wills be a doctor.
exercises.explain: will 是情态动词，不能加 s。

exercises.q: Robots ______ us with housework in the future.
exercises.explain: in the future 是将来时间，用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: There ______ more electric cars on the road in ten years.
exercises.explain: There will be 表示将来某物将会存在。

exercises.q: My brother thinks he ______ a famous scientist one day.
exercises.explain: one day 表示将来，用 will be 表预测。

exercises.q: People ______ on the moon in the future.
exercises.explain: in the future 提示用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: In 2050, cities ______ be smarter than today.
exercises.explain: In 2050 是将来时间，用 will 表预测。

exercises.q: I believe our team ______ win the match next week.
exercises.explain: believe 表示主观预测，用 will。

exercises.q: We use 'will' to talk about things we think will happen in the future.
exercises.explain: will 用于表达对未来的预测。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: They will buy a new car.
exercises.answer: Will they buy a new car?
exercises.explain: 一般将来时疑问句将 will 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'will': She is going to visit her grandma.
exercises.explain: be going to 表计划可转换为 will 表预测或意图。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: I think it will snowing tomorrow.
exercises.answer: I think it will snow tomorrow.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形，不能用现在分词。

exercises.q: Look at those dark clouds! It ______ rain soon.
exercises.explain: 根据当前迹象（乌云）预测，用 be going to。

exercises.q: By 2030, most people ______ use smartphones to pay for everything.
exercises.explain: By 2030 是将来时间，用 will 表预测。

exercises.q: The sentence "I will be able to drive a car next year" is correct.
exercises.explain: will be able to 表示将来有能力做某事。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'be able to': She will drive a car next year.
exercises.answer: She will be able to drive a car next year.
exercises.explain: will be able to 表示将来有能力做某事。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: I will can swim after taking lessons.
exercises.answer: I will be able to swim after taking lessons.
exercises.explain: will 和 can 不能连用，要用 will be able to。

exercises.q: I think self-driving cars ______ common in the future.
exercises.explain: think 表示主观预测，用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: Don't worry. I ______ you with your homework.
exercises.explain: 此处 will 表示即时决定或承诺。

exercises.q: In smart cities, traffic lights ______ themselves automatically.
exercises.explain: 描述未来智慧城市的功能，用 will 表预测。

exercises.q: Scientists believe that sea levels ______ rise because of climate change.
exercises.explain: believe 后接将来预测，用 will。

exercises.q: I'm sure you ______ pass the exam if you study hard.
exercises.explain: be sure 后接将来预测，用 will。

exercises.q: The new airport ______ open next year.
exercises.explain: next year 是将来时间，用 will 表预测。

exercises.q: We use 'will' for predictions based on what we see now.
exercises.explain: 基于当前迹象的预测用 be going to，will 多用于主观判断。

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语：从基础用法到高中拓展（含不定式对比与形式主语）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject: From Basic Use to Senior-Level Extension
grammar.usage:
动名词是动词的-ing形式，在句中起名词作用。当它作主语时，表示一种泛化的、习惯性的或已知事实的活动或概念，而不是某一次具体动作。核心结构为“动名词短语 + 单数谓语动词”，例如：Doing housework is good for children. 这里的 Doing housework 是整个句子的主语，谓语用 is。

肯定句直接以动名词短语开头；否定句在动名词前加 not，如 Not getting enough sleep affects your health.；疑问句既可用一般疑问句形式（Is doing housework good for children?），也可用特殊疑问句（What is good for children?）。动名词作主语时，谓语动词一律用单数，这是最核心的语法规则。

与不定式作主语相比，动名词更侧重“一般性、习惯性、已知事实”，而不定式更侧重“某次具体行为或将来动作”。例如：Swimming is good exercise.（泛指游泳这项活动）与 To swim in this cold river is dangerous.（指在特定情况下做这件事）。高中阶段需进一步掌握：动名词作主语时可用形式主语 it 改写，常见于 It is no use / no good / worthwhile + doing 结构；同时动名词短语可带自己的宾语、状语，构成较长的动名词短语作主语。

初中阶段主要要求识别动名词作主语并确保谓语用单数；高中阶段则要求能在书面表达中主动使用动名词作主语来增强句式多样性，并能区分动名词与现在分词、不定式作主语的语用差异。

易错点：一是动名词作主语时谓语误用复数；二是把进行时态中的现在分词误认为动名词；三是动名词短语较长时找不到真正的主语核心；四是不定式与动名词作主语时语感差异把握不准。
forms: 动名词短语 + 单数谓语：Doing housework is good for children.
否定：Not + 动名词短语 + 单数谓语：Not exercising regularly leads to health problems.
一般疑问：Is + 动名词短语 + 其他？：Is reading in bed bad for your eyes?
形式主语：It is no use + 动名词短语：It is no use crying over spilt milk.
动名词短语带宾语/状语：Watching too much TV at night affects your sleep.
动名词作主语与不定式对比：Swimming is fun. / To swim in this weather is crazy.
notes: 动名词作主语时，谓语动词必须用单数，即使动名词短语中包含复数名词也不能改变谓语单数形式。
高考书面表达中，动名词作主语常用于开头句或主题句，能有效提升句式多样性，但不要连续多句都用同一结构。
注意区分动名词作主语与现在分词作表语或状语：动名词具有名词性，现在分词具有形容词或副词性。
在 It is no use / no good / worthwhile 结构中，动名词是真正主语，it 只是形式主语，不要再用不定式替代。
动名词作主语多用于泛指或已知事实，若强调某次具体行为或将来动作，应优先考虑不定式作主语。

grammar.key: Modal Verbs for Advice / 情态动词表建议
grammar.title: 情态动词表建议：should / ought to / could / might / must / had better
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verbs for Advice: should / ought to / could / might / must / had better
grammar.usage:
情态动词表建议时，最核心的结构是“情态动词 + 动词原形”，用来告诉对方“最好做什么、可以做什么、千万别做什么”。肯定句直接使用“主语 + 情态动词 + 动词原形”，例如 You should talk to your parents. 否定句在情态动词后加 not，例如 You shouldn't stay up too late. 一般疑问句把情态动词提到主语前，例如 Should I call the doctor? 特殊疑问句则在疑问词后接情态动词，例如 What should I do next?

在表建议的多个情态动词中，should 是最常用、语气最温和的表达，表示“按常理、按经验应该做”。ought to 与 should 意思接近，但语气更正式，多用于书面语或英式英语，且否定形式 ought not to 在日常口语中较少出现。could 和 might 用于提出更委婉、更不确定的建议，常翻译为“可以试试、不妨”，例如 You could try writing a list. must 表示强烈建议，带有“必须、一定要”的语气，接近命令，例如 You must see a doctor. had better 表示“最好做某事”，含有“如果不做会有不好后果”的暗示，否定形式是 had better not，后面同样接动词原形。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 should 和 must 的基本用法，能区分 should 表建议、must 表义务。高中阶段则要进一步掌握 ought to、could、might、had better 在建议语境中的语气差异，并能在书面表达中根据对象和场合选择恰当的情态动词。例如给朋友写信可以用 should 或 could，写正式建议信时用 ought to 或 might 更得体，而规章制度中表强烈要求时用 must。

易错点一：情态动词后不能加 to，不能说 should to do 或 must to do，但 ought to 本身含有 to，后面接动词原形。易错点二：情态动词没有人称和数的变化，第三人称单数也不加 s，例如 He should go，不是 He shoulds go。易错点三：had better 虽然含有 had，但并不是过去时，它用于现在或将来的建议，后面接动词原形。易错点四：mustn't 表示“禁止、不准”，不是“不必”，如果要表达“不必”应该用 needn't 或 don't have to。
forms: 主语 + should / ought to / could / might / must + 动词原形
主语 + should not / ought not to / must not + 动词原形
Should / Ought / Could / Must + 主语 + 动词原形?
疑问词 + should / could / might + 主语 + 动词原形?
主语 + had better (not) + 动词原形
主语 + might / could + 动词原形（表示更委婉的建议）
notes: 情态动词后一律接动词原形，不能加 to、doing 或过去式；但 ought to 是固定搭配，本身带 to。
should 表建议时语气温和，must 表建议时语气强硬，高考书面表达中要根据建议对象和场合区分使用，避免语气过重或过轻。
could 和 might 表建议时比 should 更委婉，常用于正式信函或对不熟悉的人提出建议，体现语域意识。
had better 的否定形式是 had better not，不是 hadn't better；它含有“否则会有不良后果”的暗示，语气比 should 更强。
mustn't 不是“不必”，而是“禁止”；高考语法填空和短文改错中常考 mustn't 与 needn't / don't have to 的区别。

grammar.key: First Conditional (If-clause) / 第一条件句 (If 从句)
grammar.title: 第一条件句（If 从句）及其拓展：will / can / may / might / 现在时主句
grammar.titleEn: First Conditional (If-clause) and Its Extensions: will / can / may / might / Present Main Clause
grammar.usage:
第一条件句用于谈论现在或将来真实、可能发生的情况及其可能产生的结果。其核心结构是：If 从句使用现在时态（一般现在时或现在进行时），主句使用将来时态或情态动词加动词原形。肯定句如：If you study hard, you will pass the exam. 否定句在从句或主句中加 not，如：If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus. 疑问句可对主句提问，如：What will you do if it rains? 也可对从句提问，如：If he comes late, will you wait for him?

第一条件句与零条件句的区别在于：零条件句表示普遍真理或习惯，主从句都用现在时；第一条件句表示具体情境下的可能结果，主句常用 will 或情态动词。与第二条件句的区别在于：第二条件句表示假设或不太可能实现的情况，从句用过去时，主句用 would 加动词原形。

初中阶段通常只要求掌握“If + 一般现在时，主句用 will”这一基本模式。高中阶段则需拓展到：从句可用现在进行时表示当前正在发生的情况；主句可用情态动词 can、may、might、should 等表达可能性、建议或允许；主句也可用现在时态表示习惯性结果或同时发生的情况。此外，高中阶段还需注意 if 从句与 unless、as long as、provided that 等条件表达的替换关系，以及 if 从句在句首或句末时标点符号的使用。

易错点一：在 if 从句中误用 will 表示将来。英语条件句中，if 引导的条件状语从句不用 will 表示将来，而用现在时态。易错点二：主句与从句时态搭配混乱。第一条件句的主句通常用将来时或情态动词，但如果表示习惯性结果，主句也可用一般现在时。易错点三：混淆第一条件句与零条件句。零条件句用于普遍真理，如 If you heat ice, it melts；第一条件句用于具体情境，如 If you heat the ice now, it will melt quickly. 易错点四：在书面语中忽略主从句之间的逗号使用规则。当 if 从句位于句首时，主句前需加逗号；当 if 从句位于句末时，通常不加逗号。
forms: If + 一般现在时, 主句 will + 动词原形
If + 一般现在时, 主句 can / may / might / should + 动词原形
If + 现在进行时, 主句 will / 现在进行时
If + 一般现在时, 主句 一般现在时（表示习惯或普遍结果）
主句 will + 动词原形 + if + 一般现在时（从句后置，不加逗号）
If + 一般现在时, 祈使句（表示建议或指令）
notes: 高考书面语中，if 从句位于句首时主句前必须加逗号；从句位于句末时通常不加逗号。
在正式语域中，if 条件句的主句若表达可能性而非确定性，优先使用 may 或 might 而非 will，以体现语气的分寸感。
不要将 if 从句中的现在进行时误解为将来进行时。If you are spending more time on it 表示当前正在发生的情况，而非将来。
高考语法填空常考 if 从句与 unless 的转换。unless 相当于 if...not，但语气更强，且不能用于所有否定条件句。
注意主句使用现在时态时，整个句子表达的是习惯性结果或同时发生的情况，而非将来结果，这与零条件句有交叉，但语境更具体。

examples.cn: 如果你加热冰，它会融化。

examples.cn: 如果你感到累了，可以休息一会儿。

examples.cn: 如果数据显示出明显趋势，委员会可能会批准这项提案。
