exercises.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: if 从句表示将来可能的情况时用一般现在时，不用 will。

exercises.q: If he ______ (come) to the party, I will be very happy.
exercises.explain: if 从句主语是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词加 s。

exercises.q: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 rains。

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you will be late. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: If you hurry, you will not be late.
exercises.explain: 将 if 从句和主句都改为肯定形式，注意主句加 not。

exercises.q: If she will call me, I will tell her the news.
exercises.answer: If she calls me, I will tell her the news.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 calls。

exercises.q: You will be late for school if you ______ up now.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时表示将来条件，主句用 will。

exercises.q: If she ______ hard, she can pass the exam.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用情态动词 can 加动词原形。

exercises.q: We ______ a picnic if the weather is nice.
exercises.explain: 主句表示将来可能的结果，用 will 加动词原形。

exercises.q: If you ______ too much ice cream, you may feel sick.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句可用 may 表示可能的结果。

exercises.q: We will go to the beach if it ______ (be) sunny tomorrow.
exercises.explain: if 从句表示将来条件时用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you ______ (miss) the bus.
exercises.explain: 主句表示将来结果，用 will 加动词原形。

exercises.q: If you study hard, you will get good grades.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will，结构正确。

exercises.q: We will go to the park if it is sunny. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Will we go to the park if it is sunny?
exercises.explain: 将主句的 will 提到句首构成一般疑问句。

exercises.q: If you eat too much, you will get fat. (用 may 改写)
exercises.answer: If you eat too much, you may get fat.
exercises.explain: 主句可用 may 表示可能性，语气比 will 更不确定。

exercises.q: You will catch a cold if you don't wears a coat.
exercises.answer: You will catch a cold if you don't wear a coat.
exercises.explain: don't 后面接动词原形，不能用 wears。

exercises.q: If you ______ more time getting the child to do the job than doing it yourself, you are doing it right.
exercises.explain: if 从句用现在进行时描述当前正在进行的情况，与主句现在进行时呼应。

exercises.q: If you ______ (feel) tired, you should take a rest.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时表示条件，主句用 should 给建议。

exercises.q: If you are spending more time helping than doing it yourself, then you are doing it right.
exercises.explain: if 从句和主句都用现在进行时描述同时发生的情况，结构正确。

exercises.q: If you don't water the plants, they will die. (用 unless 改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you water the plants, they will die.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if...not，后接肯定形式。

exercises.q: If you will see John, please tell him to call me.
exercises.answer: If you see John, please tell him to call me.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 see。

exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时表示条件，be able to 的 be 用 is。

exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时表示将来条件，主句用 might 表示可能。

exercises.q: If it ______ cold tonight, we will turn on the heater.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时表示将来可能的情况。

exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 can 表示可能的结果。

exercises.explain: if 从句否定形式用 doesn't 加动词原形。

exercises.explain: 表示普遍真理时，主句也用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If he will be able to come, he will call us.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为 is able to come。

exercises.answer: If you study hard, you will be able to pass the exam.
exercises.explain: can 可转换为 will be able to 表示将来的能力。

exercises.answer: If it doesn't rain, the match will not be cancelled.

exercises.answer: If she doesn't hurry, she will miss the bus.
exercises.explain: doesn't 后面接动词原形，不能用 hurries。

exercises.q: If you ______ more time getting the child to do this job than it would take to do it yourself, then you're doing it right.
exercises.explain: if 从句用现在进行时描述当前正在进行的动作，与主句现在进行时构成同时发生的关系。

exercises.q: If you ______ (heat) ice, it ______ (melt).
exercises.explain: 表示科学事实或普遍真理时，if 从句和主句都用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If you're spending more time getting the child to do this job than it would take to do it yourself, then you're doing it right.
exercises.explain: if 从句和主句都用现在进行时描述同时发生的情况，结构正确。

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you will miss the train. (用 unless 改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you hurry, you will miss the train.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if...not，后接肯定形式。

exercises.q: If you will see John, please tell him to call me.
exercises.answer: If you see John, please tell him to call me.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 see。

exercises.q: If the weather ______ good tomorrow, we ______ a picnic by the lake.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will 表示将来结果。

exercises.q: If you ______ to the instructions carefully, you ______ how to operate the machine.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will 表示可能的结果。

exercises.q: If he ______ able to finish the project on time, he will inform the manager.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，be able to 的 be 用 is。

exercises.q: You ______ the exam unless you ______ more effort.
exercises.explain: unless 从句用一般现在时，主句用 won't 表示否定结果。

exercises.q: If she ______ (not leave) now, she ______ (miss) the last train.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时否定形式，主句用 will 表示将来结果。

exercises.q: If you ______ (be) more careful, you ______ (not make) so many mistakes.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 won't 表示否定结果。

exercises.q: If he will be able to solve the problem, he will tell us the answer.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为 is able to solve。

exercises.q: If you practice every day, you can improve your English. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.answer: If you practice every day, you will be able to improve your English.
exercises.explain: can 可转换为 will be able to 表示将来的能力。

exercises.q: If it rains, the match will be cancelled. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: If it doesn't rain, the match will not be cancelled.
exercises.explain: 将 if 从句和主句都改为否定形式。

exercises.q: If she doesn't hurries, she will miss the bus.
exercises.answer: If she doesn't hurry, she will miss the bus.
exercises.explain: doesn't 后面接动词原形，不能用 hurries。

exercises.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: 第一条件句中 if 从句用一般现在时表将来，不能用 will。

exercises.q: If you ______ (feel) tired, you should go to bed early.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用情态动词 should 表示建议。

exercises.q: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 rains。

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you will miss the train. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: If you hurry, you will catch the train.
exercises.explain: 将否定条件改为肯定条件，主句结果相应变为肯定。

exercises.q: If she will come to the party, I will be happy.
exercises.answer: If she comes to the party, I will be happy.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 comes。

exercises.q: You ______ the exam if you study hard.
exercises.explain: 第一条件句主句用 will + 动词原形表示可能的结果。

exercises.q: If she ______ late again, the teacher will be angry.
exercises.explain: if 从句中表示将来可能的情况要用一般现在时。

exercises.q: We will miss the bus if we ______ hurry.
exercises.explain: if 从句的否定形式用 don't + 动词原形，不用 won't。

exercises.q: If you heat ice, it ______.
exercises.explain: 表示普遍真理时，主句也用一般现在时。

exercises.q: She will call you if she ______ (get) home early.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 she 是第三人称单数，动词加 s。

exercises.q: If we ______ (not leave) now, we will be late.
exercises.explain: if 从句否定式用 don't + 动词原形。

exercises.q: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
exercises.explain: 表示普遍真理时，if 从句和主句都用一般现在时。

exercises.q: We will go to the park if it is sunny. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Will we go to the park if it is sunny?
exercises.explain: 第一条件句变疑问句时，将主句的 will 提前。

exercises.q: If you study hard, you will pass the exam. (用 can 改写主句)
exercises.answer: If you study hard, you can pass the exam.
exercises.explain: 主句可用情态动词 can 表示可能的结果。

exercises.q: You will get wet if you don't takes an umbrella.
exercises.answer: You will get wet if you don't take an umbrella.
exercises.explain: don't 后面接动词原形，不能用 takes。

exercises.q: If you ______ more time on your homework, you will get better grades.
exercises.explain: 第一条件句 if 从句用一般现在时表示将来可能的情况。

exercises.q: If she ______ (keep) practicing, she will improve her English quickly.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 she 是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: If you will work hard, you will succeed.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 work。

exercises.q: If you don't water the plants, they will die. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: If you water the plants, they will live.
exercises.explain: 将否定条件改为肯定条件，主句结果相应变为肯定。

grammar.key: Future with 'will' for Prediction / 用 'will' 表示未来预测
grammar.title: 用 will 表示未来预测（含 be going to / may / might / could 的对比与拓展）
grammar.titleEn: Future with 'will' for Prediction (with be going to / may / might / could)
grammar.usage:
“will + 动词原形”是英语中最常用的将来时结构之一，核心功能是表示说话人对未来事件的预测、判断或推测。这种预测通常基于个人看法、经验、常识或对未来的想象，而不是已经存在的明显证据。肯定句结构为“主语 + will + 动词原形”，否定句在 will 后加 not，常缩写为 won't；一般疑问句将 will 提到主语之前，回答时用“Yes, 主语 + will.”或“No, 主语 + won't.”。

在初中阶段，学生主要掌握 will 表示“将来会发生的事”，常与 tomorrow、next week、in the future、by 2050 等时间状语连用。到了高中阶段，需要进一步区分 will 与 be going to 在预测功能上的差异：will 更强调说话人当下的主观判断、推测或对遥远未来的展望，而 be going to 更强调基于现有迹象或证据做出的预测，即“有迹可循”的预测。例如看到乌云密布时说“It is going to rain.”比“It will rain.”更自然，因为预测依据是眼前的天气迹象。

此外，高中阶段还应将 will 与 may、might、could 等情态动词进行对比。will 表示说话人对未来预测的把握较大，语气较为确定；may 表示“可能”，语气中等；might 和 could 表示“或许、有可能”，语气更弱、更不确定。在书面表达中，适当使用 may/might/could 替代 will，可以使预测语气更加严谨、客观，符合高考书面语对语域和准确性的要求。

易错点一：will 后面必须接动词原形，不能接动词的第三人称单数、过去式或不定式。易错点二：在 if、when、as soon as 等引导的时间或条件状语从句中，即使表示将来，从句中通常用一般现在时，而不用 will。易错点三：will 表示预测时，不能与 be going to 在所有语境中随意互换，需根据是否有现有证据判断。易错点四：will 的否定缩写 won't 容易与 want 混淆，拼写时要注意。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + will + 动词原形
否定句：主语 + will not (won't) + 动词原形
一般疑问句：Will + 主语 + 动词原形?
预测语气弱化：主语 + may / might / could + 动词原形
基于迹象的预测：主语 + be going to + 动词原形
时间/条件状语从句：if / when / as soon as + 主语 + 一般现在时, 主句 + will + 动词原形
notes: will 后必须接动词原形，不可写成 will goes、will went 或 will to do。
高考书面表达中，表达对未来趋势的推测时，可交替使用 will、may、might、could，避免重复，同时体现语气的层次感。
在 if 和 when 引导的从句中，即使语义指向未来，从句也要用一般现在时，主句才用 will。
be going to 用于预测时强调“有现有迹象”，will 更侧重“主观判断或远期展望”，在语境中要区分使用。
won't 是 will not 的缩写，注意拼写中撇号位置，不要与 want 混淆。

examples.cn: 我认为未来机器人会帮我们打扫房子。

examples.cn: 明天会是晴天，所以我们可以去野餐。

examples.cn: 看那些乌云！很快就要下雨了。

examples.en: By 2050, self-driving cars will find parking spaces by themselves.
examples.cn: 到2050年，自动驾驶汽车将会自己找到停车位。

examples.en: Scientists predict that global temperatures may rise by two degrees by the end of this century.
examples.cn: 科学家预测，到本世纪末全球气温可能上升两度。

examples.en: If cities continue to grow at this rate, housing prices might become unaffordable for many young people.
examples.cn: 如果城市继续以这个速度增长，房价可能会让许多年轻人负担不起。

exercises.q: I think it ______ sunny tomorrow.
exercises.explain: tomorrow 是将来时间，用 will + 动词原形表示预测。

exercises.q: She ______ (visit) her grandma next Sunday.
exercises.explain: next Sunday 是将来时间，用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形，应改为 will go。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: I will buy a new bike.
exercises.answer: I will not buy a new bike.
exercises.explain: will 的否定形式是 will not，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: They will plays basketball after school.
exercises.answer: They will play basketball after school.
exercises.explain: will 后必须用动词原形 play，不能加 s。

exercises.q: Robots ______ our houses in the future.
exercises.explain: in the future 表示将来，主语 robots 后用 will clean。

exercises.q: My brother ______ twelve years old next week.
exercises.explain: next week 是将来时间，用 will be 表示未来事实。

exercises.q: ______ you ______ me tomorrow?
exercises.explain: tomorrow 提示将来，一般疑问句用 Will 开头。

exercises.q: There ______ more tall buildings in our city in ten years.
exercises.explain: in ten years 表示十年后，there be 句型的将来形式是 there will be。

exercises.q: I ______ (be) a doctor when I grow up.
exercises.explain: when I grow up 表示将来，用 will be 表示未来职业预测。

exercises.q: They ______ (not go) to school tomorrow because it is a holiday.
exercises.explain: tomorrow 提示将来，否定形式用 will not + 动词原形。

exercises.q: The sentence "We will have a test next Monday." is correct.
exercises.explain: next Monday 是将来时间，will have 结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: She will come to the party.
exercises.answer: Will she come to the party?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 will 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "will": He is going to play football this afternoon.
exercises.answer: He will play football this afternoon.
exercises.explain: be going to 表将来时可改写为 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: I will am happy to see you tomorrow.
exercises.answer: I will be happy to see you tomorrow.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形 be，而不是 am。

exercises.q: By 2050, most cars ______ electric.
exercises.explain: By 2050 是将来时间，用 will be 表示对未来的预测。

exercises.q: The weather report says it ______ (rain) tomorrow afternoon.
exercises.explain: tomorrow afternoon 是将来时间，用 will rain 表示预测。

exercises.explain: will 和 can 不能连用，应改为 will be able to speak。

exercises.answer: She will be able to finish the work tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 表示将来的能力用 will be able to。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: He will is a great scientist in the future.
exercises.answer: He will be a great scientist in the future.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形 be，而不是 is。

exercises.q: Don't worry. I ______ you with your homework.
exercises.explain: 此处表示说话时的承诺，用 will help。

exercises.q: I believe scientists ______ a cure for the disease one day.
exercises.explain: one day 表示将来某一天，用 will find 表示预测。

exercises.q: The train ______ at 9 o'clock tonight, so we have enough time.
exercises.explain: tonight 是将来时间，用 will leave 表示未来安排。

exercises.q: Maybe people ______ on Mars in the future.
exercises.explain: in the future 提示将来，用 will live 表示对未来的预测。

exercises.q: If you study hard, you ______ (pass) the exam.
exercises.explain: if 条件句表将来时，主句用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.explain: promise 后表示承诺，用 will not + 动词原形。

exercises.q: The sentence "There will be more robots in factories in the future." is correct.
exercises.explain: there will be 是 there be 句型的将来形式，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: They will move to a new city next year.
exercises.answer: Will they move to a new city next year?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 will 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: The meeting will start at 8 o'clock.
exercises.answer: The meeting will not start at 8 o'clock.
exercises.explain: will 的否定形式是 will not，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: Will you to come to my birthday party tomorrow?
exercises.answer: Will you come to my birthday party tomorrow?
exercises.explain: will 后直接接动词原形，不需要 to。

exercises.q: By the time you arrive, the concert ______ already ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导时间状语从句时，主句常用将来完成时 will have done。

exercises.q: By 2030, the city ______ (complete) the construction of the new subway line.
exercises.explain: by 2030 常与将来完成时连用，表示到将来某时已完成的动作。

exercises.q: The sentence "By next month, I will have finished reading this book." is correct.
exercises.explain: by next month 与将来完成时 will have done 搭配正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "will be able to": She can drive a car after she gets her license.
exercises.answer: She will be able to drive a car after she gets her license.
exercises.explain: 表示将来获得的能力用 will be able to。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: By the end of this year, he will finished his research.
exercises.answer: By the end of this year, he will have finished his research.
exercises.explain: by the end of this year 需用将来完成时 will have done。

exercises.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ the picnic indoors.
exercises.explain: if 条件句表将来时，主句用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: I'm sure that self-driving cars ______ more common in the next decade.
exercises.explain: in the next decade 是将来时间，用 will become 表示预测。

exercises.q: The company has announced that it ______ a new smart city project next year.
exercises.explain: next year 提示将来，宾语从句中用 will launch 表示未来计划。

exercises.q: Don't call me at 8 tonight. I ______ a meeting then.
exercises.explain: at 8 tonight 表示将来某一具体时刻，用将来进行时 will be doing。

exercises.q: She ______ (probably / pass) the interview because she has prepared well.
exercises.explain: probably 常放在 will 后，表示对未来可能性的预测。

exercises.q: The new technology ______ (change) the way we live in the coming years.
exercises.explain: in the coming years 是将来时间，用 will change 表示预测。

exercises.q: The sentence "He will be able to solve the problem after more practice." is correct.
exercises.explain: will be able to 表示将来的能力，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: The new policy will take effect next month.
exercises.answer: Will the new policy take effect next month?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 will 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: The government will approve the plan.
exercises.answer: The government will not approve the plan.
exercises.explain: will 的否定形式是 will not，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The scientists will be able to finding a solution soon.
exercises.answer: The scientists will be able to find a solution soon.
exercises.explain: be able to 后接动词原形，不能用 finding。

exercises.q: By 2050, most cars in big cities ______ electric.
exercises.explain: by 2050 是明确的未来时间，需用 will + 动词原形表示预测。

exercises.q: Next year, my brother ______ (be) fifteen years old.
exercises.explain: next year 是未来时间，用 will be 表示未来事实。

exercises.q: The sentence 'I will go to the park yesterday' is correct.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是过去时间，不能与 will 连用。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: He will come to the party.
exercises.answer: He will not come to the party.
exercises.explain: will 的否定形式是 will not，缩写为 won't。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: I will to visit my grandparents this Sunday.
exercises.answer: I will visit my grandparents this Sunday.
exercises.explain: will 后直接跟动词原形，不能加 to。

exercises.q: I think it ______ tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
exercises.explain: tomorrow 与 I think 搭配表示对未来天气的预测，用 will rain。

exercises.q: Don't worry. The bus ______ soon.
exercises.explain: soon 表示不久的将来，用 will arrive 表示预测。

exercises.q: In the future, robots ______ many housework for us.
exercises.explain: in the future 是未来时间，用 will do 表示对未来的预测。

exercises.q: She studies hard, so she ______ the exam.
exercises.explain: 根据现在的事实推断未来，用 will pass 表示预测。

exercises.q: I believe people ______ (live) on Mars one day.
exercises.explain: one day 表示将来的某一天，用 will live 表示预测。

exercises.q: The weather report says it ______ (be) sunny this weekend.
exercises.explain: this weekend 是未来时间，用 will be 表示预测。

exercises.q: We can use 'will' to talk about future predictions.
exercises.explain: will 的基本功能之一就是表示对未来的预测。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: They will finish the project next week.
exercises.answer: Will they finish the project next week?
exercises.explain: 一般将来时的疑问句将 will 提到主语之前。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'will': She is going to buy a new phone.
exercises.answer: She will buy a new phone.
exercises.explain: be going to 表将来时可转换为 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She wills be a doctor in the future.
exercises.answer: She will be a doctor in the future.
exercises.explain: will 没有人称和数的变化，不能用 wills。

exercises.q: By the time you arrive at the station, the train ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时，主句用将来完成时表示将来某时已完成的动作。

exercises.q: By next summer, they ______ (complete) the new bridge.
exercises.explain: by next summer 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'I will be studying at 9 tomorrow morning', 'will be studying' is the future continuous tense.
exercises.explain: will be + doing 是将来进行时，表示将来某时正在进行的动作。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'will' instead of 'be going to': We are going to hold a sports meeting next month.
exercises.answer: We will hold a sports meeting next month.
exercises.explain: be going to 表计划时可转换为 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: By the end of this year, we will finish the project.
exercises.answer: By the end of this year, we will have finished the project.
exercises.explain: by the end of this year 表示到将来某时为止，应用将来完成时。

exercises.q: If we continue to pollute the rivers, many fish ______.
exercises.explain: if 条件句用一般现在时，主句用 will 表示对未来的预测。

exercises.q: I'm not sure whether he ______ on time, but I hope so.
exercises.explain: whether 引导的宾语从句中，用 will 表示对将来情况的不确定预测。

exercises.q: Scientists predict that sea levels ______ significantly by 2100.
exercises.explain: by 2100 是未来时间，用 will rise 表示科学预测。

exercises.q: Don't call me at 8 p.m. I ______ a meeting then.
exercises.explain: at 8 p.m. then 表示将来某一具体时刻正在进行的动作，用将来进行时。

exercises.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ (cancel) the picnic.
exercises.explain: if 条件句用一般现在时，主句用 will 表示未来可能发生的结果。

exercises.q: This time next week, I ______ (lie) on the beach in Hainan.
exercises.explain: this time next week 表示将来某一时刻正在进行的动作，用将来进行时。

exercises.q: The sentence 'If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home' is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: if 引导的条件状语从句中不能用 will，应用一般现在时。

exercises.q: Rewrite as a negative sentence: The company will hire more workers next year.
exercises.answer: The company will not hire more workers next year.
exercises.explain: will 的否定形式是 will not，可缩写为 won't。

exercises.q: Rewrite as a question: The new policy will take effect in July.
exercises.answer: Will the new policy take effect in July?
exercises.explain: 一般将来时疑问句将 will 置于句首。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: When he will come back, I will tell you.

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense for Past Actions with Present Relevance / 现在完成时表示与现在相关的过去动作
grammar.title: 现在完成时：表示与现在相关的过去动作（含与一般过去时、现在完成进行时的对比）
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense for Past Actions with Present Relevance
grammar.usage:
现在完成时由“have/has + 过去分词”构成，核心功能是站在“现在”的角度回看过去发生的动作或状态，强调该动作或状态与现在有联系。它主要有两种用法：一是表示过去某一不确定时间发生的动作，但其结果或影响延续到现在；二是表示从过去开始一直持续到现在的动作或状态。

肯定句结构为“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，否定句在 have/has 后加 not，疑问句将 have/has 提到主语之前。例如：I have seen that film.（我看过那部电影。）She has not finished her work.（她还没完成工作。）Have you ever been to Shanghai?（你去过上海吗？）

与一般过去时相比，现在完成时强调“与现在的联系”，而一般过去时只陈述过去的事实。例如：I lost my key yesterday.（昨天丢了钥匙，现在是否找到不知道。）I have lost my key.（钥匙丢了，现在还没找到。）因此，现在完成时不能与 yesterday、last week、in 2010 等明确的过去时间状语连用，而常与 already、yet、ever、never、just、recently、so far、for + 时间段、since + 时间点等连用。

初中阶段主要要求掌握“已经做完某事”和“持续一段时间”的基本用法，而高中阶段还需要进一步区分现在完成时与现在完成进行时。现在完成时强调动作的完成或结果，现在完成进行时强调动作的持续性和未完成性。例如：I have read this book.（我已经读完这本书了。）I have been reading this book.（我一直在读这本书，可能还没读完。）此外，高中阶段还要求掌握 have been to（去过某地已回来）、have gone to（去了某地还没回来）、have been in（在某地待了多久）的区别，以及瞬间动词在现在完成时中不能与时间段连用的问题。

易错点一：把瞬间动词与 for/since 时间段连用。例如“He has bought the car for two years”是错误的，应改为“He has had the car for two years”或“He bought the car two years ago”。易错点二：在现在完成时中混入具体过去时间。易错点三：混淆 have been to 和 have gone to。易错点四：在 since 引导的时间状语从句中，主句用现在完成时，从句通常用一般过去时。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + have/has + 过去分词
否定句：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词
一般疑问句：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词？
特殊疑问句：疑问词 + have/has + 主语 + 过去分词？
since + 过去时间点 / 一般过去时从句，主句用现在完成时
have been to（去过已回）/ have gone to（去了未回）/ have been in（待了多久）
notes: 瞬间动词（如 buy、borrow、leave、die、join）的现在完成时不能与 for + 时间段连用，需转换为延续性动词或改用一般过去时。
since 从句中通常用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时；since 后接时间点时，该时间点是过去的具体起点。
高考书面表达中，注意区分 have been to（已回来）和 have gone to（还没回来），主语为第三人称时尤其容易误用。
在正式书面语中，现在完成时常与 already、yet、recently、so far、up to now 等连用，避免与 yesterday、last night、in 2015 等具体过去时间混用。
注意现在完成时与现在完成进行时的语域差异：前者侧重结果，后者侧重过程，高考完形填空和语法填空中常以此作为辨析考点。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can play now.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去动作对现在有影响，所以现在可以玩了。

exercises.q: He ______ (already / eat) his breakfast.
exercises.explain: already 常用于现在完成时，表示动作已完成。

exercises.q: She has visited Beijing last year.
exercises.explain: last year 是具体过去时间，不能用现在完成时，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: I have finished my homework. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: I have saw that movie before.

exercises.explain: 现在完成时用 have + 过去分词，saw 应改为 seen。

exercises.q: She ______ in this town since 2015.
exercises.explain: since 2015 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: They ______ the new movie yet.
exercises.explain: yet 常用于现在完成时否定句，表示还没做某事。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his key, so he can't open the door.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙的结果影响现在——开不了门，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: We ______ to the new park twice this week.
exercises.explain: this week 是未结束的时间段，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: They ______ (live) here for ten years.
exercises.explain: for ten years 表示持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ (not / see) him today.
exercises.explain: today 是未结束的时间，否定用 haven't + 过去分词。

exercises.q: I have known him since I was a child.
exercises.explain: since + 过去时间点，表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时正确。

exercises.q: She has been to Shanghai. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句把 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: They have lived here for five years. (用 since 改写)
exercises.answer: They have lived here since five years ago.
exercises.explain: for + 时间段可转换为 since + 时间点。

exercises.q: She have finished her work.
exercises.explain: 主语是第三人称单数时用 has，不是 have。

exercises.q: Great changes ______ in our town over the past few years.
exercises.explain: over the past few years 表示从过去到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ (be) a teacher since she graduated.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语，主句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He has gone to Beijing, so he is not here now.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示去了某地还没回来，所以现在不在这里。

exercises.answer: He hasn't finished his homework yet.
exercises.explain: already 在否定句中改为 yet，表示还没完成。

exercises.q: She has joined the club for two years.
exercises.answer: She has been in the club for two years.
exercises.explain: join 是短暂动词，不能与 for two years 连用，应改为 be in。

exercises.q: He ______ the book for two weeks. He needs to return it.
exercises.explain: borrow 是短暂动词，不能与 for two weeks 连用，要用延续性动词 keep。

exercises.q: — Have you ever ______ to Beijing? — Yes, I ______ there last summer.
exercises.explain: have been to 表示去过某地；last summer 是具体过去时间，用一般过去时。

exercises.q: The town ______ a lot since I moved here.
exercises.explain: since 引导的时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ my pen. Can I use yours?
exercises.explain: 丢笔的结果影响现在——现在没笔用，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: We ______ (not / hear) from him recently.
exercises.explain: recently 常与现在完成时连用，否定用 haven't + 过去分词。

exercises.q: How long ______ you ______ (study) English?
exercises.explain: How long 询问持续时间，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I have bought this bike for three years.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂动词，不能与 for three years 连用，应改为 have had。

exercises.q: They have lived here since 2010. (对 since 2010 提问)
exercises.answer: How long have they lived here?

exercises.explain: never 在疑问句中改为 ever，表示"曾经"。

exercises.q: They have finished the work yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是具体过去时间，不能用现在完成时，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，表示"过去的过去"，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: By the end of last year, they ______ (build) three new schools in the area.
exercises.explain: by the end of last year 表示到过去某时间为止，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: He has been in the army for three years.
exercises.explain: be in the army 是延续性表达，可与 for three years 连用。

exercises.q: He has been a teacher for five years. (用 since 改写)
exercises.answer: He has been a teacher since five years ago.
exercises.explain: for + 时间段可转换为 since + 时间点。

exercises.q: He has died for three years.
exercises.answer: He has been dead for three years.
exercises.explain: die 是短暂动词，不能与 for three years 连用，应改为 be dead。

exercises.q: It is the first time that I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: It is the first time that 从句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The old house ______ empty since its owner passed away.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时表示持续状态。

exercises.q: — Where is Tom? — He ______ to the library. He'll be back soon.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示去了某地还没回来，符合语境。

exercises.q: I ______ my keys. I can't find them anywhere.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙的结果影响现在——现在找不到，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ (work) in this company since she graduated from college.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时。

exercises.explain: This is the most... I have ever done 是固定句型，用现在完成时。

exercises.explain: buy 是短暂动词，不能与 since 连用，应改为 has had。

exercises.q: I have never seen such a wonderful film. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Have you ever seen such a wonderful film?
exercises.explain: never 在疑问句中改为 ever，表示"曾经"。

exercises.q: They have already cleaned the classroom. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: They haven't cleaned the classroom yet.
exercises.explain: already 在否定句中改为 yet，表示还没完成。

exercises.q: I have received his letter two days ago.
exercises.answer: I received his letter two days ago.
exercises.explain: two days ago 是具体过去时间，不能用现在完成时，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can go out to play now.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去动作对现在造成的结果（作业已完成，现在可以出去玩）。

exercises.q: The students ______ (clean) the classroom. It looks very tidy now.
exercises.explain: 过去动作对现在造成结果（教室现在很干净），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I have visited the Great Wall last year.
exercises.explain: last year 是具体过去时间，不能与现在完成时连用，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using the present perfect tense: I lost my key. (I still can't find it.)
exercises.explain: 用现在完成时表达过去动作对现在的影响（现在仍找不到钥匙）。

exercises.q: He have finished his homework.
exercises.explain: 主语 He 是第三人称单数，应用 has 而非 have。

exercises.q: She ______ in this town since she was a child.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间点，表示从过去持续到现在的动作，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: We can't enter the cinema because we ______ our tickets.
exercises.explain: 丢票发生在过去，但对现在有影响（不能进电影院），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: My brother ______ to Beijing twice.
exercises.explain: 表示过去经历且次数累计，用 have/has been to。

exercises.q: They ______ each other for ten years.
exercises.explain: for + 时间段表示动作从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ (not see) the new film yet.

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ (try) Chinese food?
exercises.explain: ever 用于现在完成时疑问句，询问过去的经历。

exercises.q: She has already finished her work.
exercises.explain: already 用于现在完成时肯定句，表示动作已经完成。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: They have finished their homework.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句将 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in the negative form: She has been to Shanghai.
exercises.answer: She has not been to Shanghai.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定句在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: I have seen him yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是具体过去时间，应用一般过去时而非现在完成时。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived at the station, the train ______.
exercises.explain: arrived 是过去动作，火车离开发生在 arrived 之前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: Great changes ______ (take) place in our city over the past ten years.
exercises.explain: over the past ten years 表示从过去到现在的时段，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The sentence 'I have been to the museum yesterday' is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是具体过去时间，不能与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'since': I started learning English in 2018. I still learn English.
exercises.explain: 用 since + 过去时间点表达从过去持续到现在的动作。

exercises.q: She has went to the library.
exercises.answer: She has gone to the library.
exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，不是 went。

exercises.q: The town ______ a lot since the new factory was built.
exercises.explain: since 引导过去时间点，主句用现在完成时表示从过去持续到现在的变化。

exercises.q: I ______ my English teacher for five years, and I still keep in touch with her.
exercises.explain: for + 时间段表示动作从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.explain: already 与现在完成时连用，表示已完成的动作对现在的影响。

exercises.q: This is the first time I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: This is the first time 句型要求用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ (live) in this town for centuries, and his family still lives here.
exercises.explain: for centuries 表示持续到现在的动作，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ (not hear) from him since he moved to another city.
exercises.explain: since 引导过去时间点，主句用现在完成时否定形式。

exercises.q: The sentence 'She has been living here since 2010' is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: since 2010 表示从过去持续到现在的动作，现在完成进行时也正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'for': She moved to this city five years ago. She still lives here.

exercises.explain: 用 for + 时间段表达从过去持续到现在的动作。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a negative question: They have finished the project.

exercises.q: The sentence 'The town has changed dramatically since the new policy was introduced' is grammatically correct.

grammar.key: Passive Voice (Present Continuous) / 被动语态 (现在进行时)
grammar.title: 现在进行时的被动语态：am/is/are being done 及其与一般现在时被动、情态动词被动的拓展对比
grammar.titleEn: Present Continuous Passive: am/is/are being done
grammar.usage:
现在进行时的被动语态用于强调“此刻/现阶段正在被进行的动作”，说话重心是承受动作的人或事物，而不是执行者。其核心结构为：主语 + am/is/are + being + 过去分词。肯定句如：The road is being repaired. 否定句在 be 动词后加 not：The road is not being repaired. 一般疑问句将 be 动词提至句首：Is the road being repaired? 特殊疑问句则用“疑问词 + is/are + 主语 + being + 过去分词”，如 What is being discussed now?

与一般现在时被动语态（am/is/are + done）相比，现在进行时被动强调动作“正在发生”，而一般现在时被动多表示经常性、习惯性或客观状态。例如：The house is cleaned every day.（每天被打扫）与 The house is being cleaned now.（此刻正在被打扫）含义不同。与现在完成时被动（has/have been done）相比，现在进行时被动不强调“已经完成”，而是强调“正在进行”。

初中阶段通常只要求识别“be + 过去分词”的基本被动形式，高中阶段则要求掌握“be + being + 过去分词”的进行时被动，并能在阅读和写作中区分“正在被做”与“已经被做”“经常被做”的差异。高中还应关注该结构在新闻报道、科技说明文、社会议题讨论中的高频使用，例如：New policies are being introduced to reduce pollution.

易错点一：漏掉 being。很多学生写成 The bridge is built now，但正确形式应为 The bridge is being built now，因为 now 提示动作正在进行。易错点二：把 being 误写成 been。been 用于完成时被动，being 用于进行时被动，二者不可替换。易错点三：过去分词形式错误。不规则动词的过去分词需准确记忆，如 build—built—built，write—wrote—written。易错点四：在不需要强调执行者时硬加 by。如果执行者不明确或不重要，应省略 by 短语，使句子更简洁自然。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + am/is/are + being + 过去分词
否定式：主语 + am/is/are + not + being + 过去分词
一般疑问式：Am/Is/Are + 主语 + being + 过去分词?
特殊疑问式：疑问词 + am/is/are + 主语 + being + 过去分词?
与情态动词连用：主语 + 情态动词 + be being + 过去分词（如 may be being discussed）
省略 by 施动者：主语 + am/is/are + being + 过去分词（不强调执行者时）
notes: 高考书面语中，现在进行时被动常与 now, at present, currently, at the moment 等时间状语连用，注意不要与一般现在时被动混淆。
进行时被动中 being 不可省略，也不可换成 been；been 只用于完成时被动。
在正式语域中，若需表达“某事可能正在被讨论/处理”，可用情态动词 + be being + 过去分词，如 may be being considered，这是高中阅读中的高频结构。
部分动词如 believe, know, love, want 等表示心理或状态的动词，通常不用于进行时被动，应使用一般现在时被动或完成时被动。
写作中若执行者未知或不重要，应省略 by 短语，避免句子冗长；只有在需要强调执行者时才使用 by。

exercises.q: The authorities are taking measures to prevent the spread of the disease. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Measures are being taken by the authorities to prevent the spread of the disease.
exercises.explain: 主动改被动，measures 作主语，用 are being taken，不定式目的状语保留。

exercises.q: The company is developing a new technology that could revolutionize the industry. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: A new technology that could revolutionize the industry is being developed by the company.
exercises.explain: 主动改被动，a new technology 作主语，定语从句保留，用 is being developed。

exercises.q: The old power plants are being replace by renewable energy facilities across the country.
exercises.answer: The old power plants are being replaced by renewable energy facilities across the country.
exercises.explain: replace 的过去分词是 replaced，被动语态中应用 replaced。
